jobs.descriptionText: <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a <strong>Lead Learning Experience Designer</strong> to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference.&nbsp;</span></p> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, AI-enabled support, workshop, or embedded guidance.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Develop learning experiences that support contributors in understanding new tools, workflows, policies, governance processes, and community practices across Wikimedia projects.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Rapidly prototype, test and iterate on learning experiences, using modern authoring tools, multimedia, and AI tools.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Apply learning science, user-centered design, and learning experience design methodologies to create engaging, effective, and inclusive solutions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Evaluate learning effectiveness using learner feedback, participation data, and other qualitative and quantitative insights, continuously improving content based on evidence and community feedback.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Foundation's learning strategy by staying current with learning technology, online learning, AI, and digital engagement, identifying opportunities to expand and strengthen learning offerings across the movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Ensure learning resources reflect Wikimedia's values of openness, collaboration, equity, and knowledge sharing.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Qualifications</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Required</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience designing and developing digital learning experiences for diverse, global audiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Demonstrated experience creating engaging e-learning, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning solutions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience using a learning management system (LMS) to develop, organize, and publish learning content.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Demonstrated ability to diagnose capability gaps, identify the right interventions, and rapidly design, build and improve learning experiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Excellent written communication and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Commitment to accessibility, inclusive design, and culturally responsive learning practices.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Preferred</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience working with volunteer communities, open knowledge initiatives, nonprofits, or international organizations.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience designing learning for multilingual audiences and collaborating across cultures and time zones.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience creating learning in modern digital environments using tools such as Rise, Storyline, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, video editing tools, AI content generation platforms, or similar technologies.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience partnering with product teams or using product design approaches, such as user research, experimentation, prototyping and iteration.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Knowledge of experimentation methods, A/B testing, learning analytics, product analytics, and continuous improvement practices.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Familiarity with Wikimedia projects, the Wikimedia movement, or open-source communities.</span></li> </ul> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>You'll Thrive in This Role If You...</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Think like a designer and builder, comfortable moving from identifying challenges to creating, testing and improving solutions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Are curious about how people learn, what motivates participation, and how to leverage modern methods and technology to create memorable learning experiences.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Are energized by ambiguity and enjoy figuring out what needs to be built rather than waiting for a predefined assignment.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Excel at collaborating with people from different backgrounds, languages, and areas of expertise.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Balance creativity with evidence and structure, using data, research, and feedback to guide decisions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Care deeply about accessibility, inclusion, and creating learning that supports equitable participation.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Are inspired by Wikimedia's mission to make knowledge freely available to everyone.</span></li> </ul> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About the Wikimedia Foundation</span></h4> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$117,437 to US$177,624 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. jobs.title: Principal, Executive Communications
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>The Wikimedia Foundation seeks a senior communications professional to lead our executive communications across a growing, global portfolio.</p> <p>This person's main responsibility is to serve as a primary communications partner to the Foundation's CEO, providing strategic counsel and direct support across internal and external communications. This includes building a comprehensive engagement strategy spanning  multiple and complex stakeholder groups. In close collaboration with colleagues on the Foundation's media relations and internal communications teams, and with the Foundation's Chief of Staff, this person will develop, shape, and implement a strategy for the CEO to communicate and advance the vision of the Wikimedia Foundation. In addition, they will support external communications for other members of the Foundation's executive team and the Board of Trustees.</p> <p>The person in this role will be responsible for proactively identifying, shaping, and executing opportunities to build the thought leadership platforms for the CEO and other Foundation executives, including securing and preparing leaders for public speaking and media engagements. This role will regularly develop communications materials for the CEO, such as speeches and remarks, talking points, social media posts, internal communications, briefing documents, and blogs. They will also develop key narratives and messaging strategies that increase the awareness and understanding of how Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects work and their value in the world, in alignment with the communications objectives of the Wikimedia Foundation. </p> <p>This role requires a candidate with previous experience supporting C-level executives; the ability to work autonomously to develop thought leadership strategies and excellent written materials; and the ability to thrive in a highly collaborative environment by creating connections across departments and teams within a globally-distributed, remote, matrixed organization. </p> <p class="p1"><em><strong>Working hours:</strong> This role requires regular working hours aligned with the Eastern Time (ET) time zone, with flexibility to work across time zones as needed to support global stakeholders and executive communications.</em></p> <p>The ideal candidate is:</p> <ul> <li><strong>An executive communications expert.</strong> You have written for CEOs and executives before; you are comfortable working directly with senior-level stakeholders to understand their priorities and translate them into a communications strategy. You are not just a communications expert; you are a strategic partner and advisor to the principals that you support. You are responsive and curious, with a high degree of executive presence. You are able to anticipate tough questions and think strategically about messages that resonate across multiple audiences. </li> <li><strong>Highly collaborative. </strong>You will be part of an international communications department that works to reach and engage numerous stakeholders through a range of global channels, including earned media, social media, and channels reaching Wikimedia volunteer and affiliate communities and Foundation staff. You can develop and integrate executive communications tactics into the overarching communications strategy of the Wikimedia Foundation. You will proactively develop relationships throughout the organization and broader volunteer communities to understand and surface trends to include in communications.</li> <li><strong>An experienced storyteller. </strong>You will develop written materials that capture the tone and voice of different executives, often working under tight deadlines. This can include writing and ghostwriting speeches, op-eds, quotes, external statements, and blog posts that have a clear point of view; guiding social media strategy that captures the tone and style of our executives; and creating a consistent internal communications strategy including regular staff emails from the CEO.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiastic about proactive external opportunities.</strong> In a swiftly evolving news and public engagement landscape, you will raise the profile of Wikimedia Foundation leadership by proactively seeking out earned media opportunities and speaking engagements, as well as co-creating thought leadership and building public presence for our leadership team. You will leverage relationships with reporters and conference organizers to identify new and compelling publications and venues for Foundation leaders to speak to key audiences. You love following technology trends and other public narratives that are relevant to our work, and you identify proactive opportunities to increase awareness about the Wikimedia projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of professional experience in communications, with several years supporting C-level executives.</li> <li>Excellent verbal communication and writing skills, including ability to adapt communications for different stakeholders.</li> <li>Unflappable composure and ability to engage with senior leadership-level presence; ability to communicate the work of the Wikimedia Foundation at multiple levels. </li> <li>Experience navigating crisis communications, including preparing executives to respond to sensitive or rapidly evolving situations in partnership with wider Communications teams.</li> <li>Proven ability to pitch stories, engage press, and manage key relationships to drive results. Experience and comfort working with reporters, staffing media interviews, and shaping articles.</li> <li>Experience developing a social media strategy customized for specific channels (LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.) in collaboration with the organization's larger social media strategy and social media team.</li> <li>Strong project management skills and experience managing multiple projects and deadlines at once, as well as an interest in both independent and collaborative work.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with experience maintaining systems and documentation for projects with multiple moving parts and stakeholders. </li> <li>Willingness to travel as needed (potential for 3 - 5 trips per year) and work across time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additionally, we’d love it if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work with colleagues who do not have English as their primary language.</li> <li>A commitment to consistently modeling the <a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/values/">Wikimedia Foundation's organizational values</a>.</li> <li>Preference for candidates based in the Eastern Time time zone.</li> <li>Preference for candidates with involvement or experience within Wikimedia communities and/or editing the Wikimedia projects.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. jobs.descriptionText: <p>The Wikimedia Foundation seeks a senior communications professional to lead our executive communications across a growing, global portfolio.</p> <p>This person's main responsibility is to serve as a primary communications partner to the Foundation's CEO, providing strategic counsel and direct support across internal and external communications. This includes building a comprehensive engagement strategy spanning&nbsp; multiple and complex stakeholder groups. In close collaboration with colleagues on the Foundation's media relations and internal communications teams, and with the Foundation's Chief of Staff, this person will develop, shape, and implement a strategy for the CEO to communicate and advance the vision of the Wikimedia Foundation. In addition, they will support external communications for other members of the Foundation's executive team and the Board of Trustees.</p> <p>The person in this role will be responsible for proactively identifying, shaping, and executing opportunities to build the thought leadership platforms for the CEO and other Foundation executives, including securing and preparing leaders for public speaking and media engagements. This role will regularly develop communications materials for the CEO, such as speeches and remarks, talking points, social media posts, internal communications, briefing documents, and blogs. They will also develop key narratives and messaging strategies that increase the awareness and understanding of how Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects work and their value in the world, in alignment with the communications objectives of the Wikimedia Foundation.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role requires a candidate with previous experience supporting C-level executives; the ability to work autonomously to develop thought leadership strategies and excellent written materials; and the ability to thrive in a highly collaborative environment by creating connections across departments and teams within a globally-distributed, remote, matrixed organization.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1"><em><strong>Working hours:</strong> This role requires regular working hours aligned with the Eastern Time (ET) time zone, with flexibility to work across time zones as needed to support global stakeholders and executive communications.</em></p> <p>The ideal candidate is:</p> <ul> <li><strong>An executive communications expert.</strong> You have written for CEOs and executives before; you are comfortable working directly with senior-level stakeholders to understand their priorities and translate them into a communications strategy. You are not just a communications expert; you are a strategic partner and advisor to the principals that you support. You are responsive and curious, with a high degree of executive presence. You are able to anticipate tough questions and think strategically about messages that resonate across multiple audiences.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Highly collaborative. </strong>You will be part of an international communications department that works to reach and engage numerous stakeholders through a range of global channels, including earned media, social media, and channels reaching Wikimedia volunteer and affiliate communities and Foundation staff. You can develop and integrate executive communications tactics into the overarching communications strategy of the Wikimedia Foundation. You will proactively develop relationships throughout the organization and broader volunteer communities to understand and surface trends to include in communications.</li> <li><strong>An experienced storyteller. </strong>You will develop written materials that capture the tone and voice of different executives, often working under tight deadlines. This can include writing and ghostwriting speeches, op-eds, quotes, external statements, and blog posts that have a clear point of view; guiding social media strategy that captures the tone and style of our executives; and creating a consistent internal communications strategy including regular staff emails from the CEO.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiastic about proactive external opportunities.</strong> In a swiftly evolving news and public engagement landscape, you will raise the profile of Wikimedia Foundation leadership by proactively seeking out earned media opportunities and speaking engagements, as well as co-creating thought leadership and building public presence for our leadership team. You will leverage relationships with reporters and conference organizers to identify new and compelling publications and venues for Foundation leaders to speak to key audiences. You love following technology trends and other public narratives that are relevant to our work, and you identify proactive opportunities to increase awareness about the Wikimedia projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of professional experience in communications, with several years supporting C-level executives.</li> <li>Excellent verbal communication and writing skills, including ability to adapt communications for different stakeholders.</li> <li>Unflappable composure and ability to engage with senior leadership-level presence; ability to communicate the work of the Wikimedia Foundation at multiple levels.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience navigating crisis communications, including preparing executives to respond to sensitive or rapidly evolving situations in partnership with wider Communications teams.</li> <li>Proven ability to pitch stories, engage press, and manage key relationships to drive results. Experience and comfort working with reporters, staffing media interviews, and shaping articles.</li> <li>Experience developing a social media strategy customized for specific channels (LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.) in collaboration with the organization's larger social media strategy and social media team.</li> <li>Strong project management skills and experience managing multiple projects and deadlines at once, as well as an interest in both independent and collaborative work.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with experience maintaining systems and documentation for projects with multiple moving parts and stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Willingness to travel as needed (potential for 3 - 5 trips per year) and work across time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additionally, we’d love it if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work with colleagues who do not have English as their primary language.</li> <li>A commitment to consistently modeling the <a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/values/">Wikimedia Foundation's organizational values</a>.</li> <li>Preference for candidates based in the Eastern Time time zone.</li> <li>Preference for candidates with involvement or experience within Wikimedia communities and/or editing the Wikimedia projects.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is $<span data-sheets-root="1">144,765 </span>to $<span data-sheets-root="1">220,063</span><strong> </strong>with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.</p> <p><strong>*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:</strong><br><strong>US States</strong>: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)<br><br><strong>Countries: </strong>Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (<em>*citizens/permanent residents only)</em><br><br>We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.</p> <p>All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.</p> <p><em><strong>If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at recruiting@wikimedia.org or +1 (415) 839-6885.</strong></em></p> <p><strong>More information</strong></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/jobs/#section-12"><strong>U.S. Benefits &amp; jobs.title: Contract Senior Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.</span></p> <h3><strong>Engineering Deliverables</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Automated Dashboards:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Telemetry Gap Analysis:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Data Sanitization Frameworks:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Behavioral Inference Reports:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate</strong></h3> <h3><strong>Scope</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.</span></p> <h3><strong>Required Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Technical:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Domain Knowledge:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Soft Skills:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Independent problem solving:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Hiring Ranges:</strong></p></div><div class="title">Remote UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£58,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£78,000 GBP</span></div></div></div>

jobs.title: Contract Staff Software Engineer-Bug Burndown
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You will help reduce Firefox’s WebCompat bug backlog by finishing or verifying the diagnosis of the long tail of site-breakage bugs, and by writing interventions or simple fixes (often with AI assistance). You turn a large queue of reported breakages into diagnosed, actionable, or fixed bugs.</span></p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Finish diagnosing, or verify the diagnosis of, long-tail WebCompat bugs.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write WebCompat interventions where appropriate.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write simple fixes (AI-assisted) and land them.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reproduce and triage incoming site-breakage reports.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Required qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Solid web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and comfort debugging real-world site breakage.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Fluent with browser devtools and cross-browser diagnosis.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Comfortable using AI tooling to speed up diagnosis and fixes.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Gecko knowledge is a strong plus (but can be taught).</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Prior WebCompat or web-standards experience.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p>

jobs.title: Contract Staff Software Engineer - (Firefox) C++,Storage Encryption
jobs.descriptionHtml: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You will help the Firefox DOM LWS team to implement tasks for Storage Encryption everywhere, helping to drive the in-progress project through to completion .</span></p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Contributing to delivering Storage Encryption Everywhere in Gecko, which may include tasks such as migrating data between schemas, implementing data storage in PBM and integration testing.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write and pass Web Platform Tests, and add Gecko tests as needed.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work through code review with the relevant Gecko module owners and iterate to landing.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Surface and help resolve any specification questions the implementation raises.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Shepherd the feature through Nightly, Beta, and Release. Fix correctness, performance issues and regressions.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Definition of done</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ship Storage Encryption Everywhere to release channel. jobs.title: Mid Market Account Executive - Indonesia
jobs.descriptionHtml: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p><strong>The Role: </strong></p> <p>Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a dynamic Mid-Market Account Executive who will focus on <strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Indonesia and living in Jakarta</span>.</strong> To excel as an Account Executive at <strong>Elastic</strong>, you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems.</p> <p>As a dynamic Mid-Market Account Executive, you will be an integral part of our growth strategy. You will drive net-new revenue and expansion within Mid-Market Accounts in an assigned territory. This is an opportunity for those passionate about empowering companies through innovative search technology and analytics, enabling them to unlock the full potential of their data.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Adoption:</strong> Fuel the adoption of Elastic’s AI-powered search solutions, Observability and Security solutions within (new) Mid-Market accounts in <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>INDONESIA </strong></span>while deepening engagement with existing ones.</li> <li><strong>Be a Trusted Advisor:</strong> Assist users and customers in harnessing the full power of search analytics to transform data into actionable insights. </li> <li><strong>Domain & cloud acumen:</strong> Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures. </li> <li><strong>Solve Complex Problems:</strong> Move beyond simple transactions to address the intricate data challenges our customers face. </li> <li><strong>Champion Open Source:</strong> Articulate the value of our advanced commercial features while advocating for our Open-Source offerings. </li> <li><strong>Identify New Use Cases:</strong> Showcase how Elastic’s solutions enable users to work more efficiently and intelligently. </li> <li><strong>Strategic Planning:</strong> Develop comprehensive business plans using community, customer, and partner ecosystems to drive significant territory growth. </li> <li><strong>Navigate Sales Cycles:</strong> Proactively identify new opportunities and successfully manage complex sales cycles. </li> <li><strong>Deep discovery & qualification:</strong> Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like <em>MEDDPICC </em>so you chase only the highest-confidence deals. </li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership:</strong> Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>The Right Blend:</strong> A combination of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. </li> <li><strong>Proven Track record:</strong> Mid-Market Accounts in <strong>Indonesia! </strong></li> <li><strong>Proven Track Record:</strong> Success in SaaS subscription sales in Mid-Market accounts, evidenced by overachievement. </li> <li><strong>Value Storytelling:</strong> The ability to craft tailored narratives that link Elastic’s technical capabilities (Search, Observability, Security) to measurable business outcomes like revenue gain or risk mitigation is critical. </li> <li><strong>Executive negotiation & closing:</strong> Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions </li> <li><strong>Technical & cloud fluency:</strong> Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including security, observability, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization. </li> <li><strong>Relationship Building:</strong> Adept at establishing credibility with both technical developers and executive leadership. </li> <li><strong>Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy:</strong> Consistent, predictable and accurate sales forecasting skills. Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up to date. Ability to create alignment across teams to accelerate deals </li> <li><strong>AI Mentality: </strong>Use new technologies for performance advantage and deal structuring. </li> <li><strong>Open-Source Appreciation:</strong> Enthusiasm for the Open-Source model and the community relying on our solutions.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</p> <p>We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email <a href="mailto:candidate_accessibility@elastic.co" target="_blank">candidate_accessibility@elastic.co</a><span class="gmail_default">.</span> We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.</p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below:</span> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf" target="_blank">Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster;</span><span style="color: #000000;"> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ofccp/pdf/pay-transp_%20English_formattedESQA508c.pdf" target="_blank">Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision</a> Poster; </span><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppabw.pdf" target="_blank">Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster and <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights.pdf" target="_blank">Know Your Rights</a> (Poster)</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Elasticsearch develops and distributes technology and information that is subject to U.S. and other countries’ export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or Russia, including the Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia (The Crimea region of Ukraine, The Donetsk People's Republic (DNR), The Luhansk People's Republic (LNR), Kherson or Zaporizhzhia). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic.</span></p> <p>Please see <a href="https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement&source=gmail&ust=1611068262479000&usg=AFQjCNG3orAPk5sJIr9WVm0ZDxYw82c5DA">here</a> for our Privacy Statement.</p></div>

jobs.title: NDT Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml: **NDT Technician** **Location:** Timika, Papua, Indonesia **Business Area:** Mining **Job Category:** Workshop **Employment Type:** Full-time **Job Purpose** The NDT Technician is responsible for performing Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) activities to ensure product quality, welding integrity, and compliance with engineering and safety standards. The role supports inspection, quality control, and documentation processes in workshop and site operations. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) activities in accordance with applicable standards and procedures. * Conduct inspection and evaluation of welded joints and fabricated components. * Interpret technical and engineering drawings for inspection purposes. * Prepare inspection reports and maintain complete quality control documentation. * Ensure inspection activities comply with safety, quality, and operational requirements. * Coordinate with engineering, workshop, and production teams during inspection processes. Support continuous improvement related to quality and inspection practices. **Position Requirements** **Education** * Minimum **Diploma 3 (D3)** in **Mechanical Engineering** or related field. **Certification** * **Level II certification in Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)** – ASNT TC 1A * **Licensed Welding Inspector** (BNSP / B4T) **Experience** * Minimum **2–5 years** of experience in: + Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) operations at **Level II** + Welding inspection in industrial projects (construction or manufacturing) + Reading and interpreting technical & engineering drawings Preparing inspection reports and quality control documentation **Technical Skills** * NDT inspection and evaluation * Welding inspection * Technical drawing interpretation Quality documentation and reporting **Software Skills (Required)** * AutoCAD 2D & 3D * SolidWorks * Application Inventor Microsoft Office (Excel & Word, PPT) **Language Skills** * **Proficient in English** (spoken and written) **How to apply** Submit your application via our website www.sandvik.com/career Applications close: 08 November 2026 ***Only candidates who meet the qualifications will be processed***

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front-End)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **What you will be doing:** * **Ship End-to-End:** Own features from design to release—spot UX gaps early, ship core value first, log tech debt deliberately, and clean it up later. * **Partner with Product:** Analyze technical feasibility, document requirements, estimate timelines, and build work plans alongside product managers. * **Empower the Team:** Unblock peers through prompt PR reviews, pair programming, and hands-on coaching. * **Work Smarter with AI:** Leverage AI tools for routine tasks (unit tests, docs, clarifications) to maximize time spent on core logic. * **Lead & Architect:** Formulate web frontend architecture, drive tech stack decisions, and uphold engineering best practices. ### **What we need from you:** * **Experience:** **Minimum 3 years** of software engineering experience building Web Frontend applications (**ReactJS**). * **Technical Core:** Strong grasp of web frontend architecture, OOP, and software design patterns. * **Product Mindset:** A strong sense of ownership—treating what you ship as your own codebase is a must. * **Pragmatic Learner:** Drive to learn new technologies and apply them practically to solve business problems. * **Collaborative Spirit:** Outstanding problem-solving skills, open-mindedness to learn from peers, and a desire to elevate your team. **Nice-to-Haves:** * Full-stack versatility and readiness to tackle new frameworks across the stack. * Experience deploying software on scalable cloud platforms (e.g., AWS).

jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer - Global Payment - Jakarta
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location :** Jakarta **Team :** Frontend **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A137843 Responsibilities About Global Payment Team Our Web and Client team in Global Payment is committed to building a highly integrated payment product that can be easily connected to the Web, App, cross-platform and other forms of Global Payment capabilities. In addition, we provide efficient and comprehensive services to developers, merchants and others through a series of platforms. Responsibilities - Build global consumer digital wallets and payment products to support global ecosystem business and users. As part of the international payment team, participate in system design, research and development, technological innovation, etc; - Build payment products for consumer users and cross platform products based on Web technology, including mobile and PC products; - Collaborate with product design, product management and software engineering teams to drive business success in efficiency and safety; - Keep at the forefront of emerging web-based technologies and trends, research and evaluate the latest web development frameworks, apply new technologies to drive iterative product improvements. Qualifications Minimum Qualification(s) - Experience in developing frontend web applications - Strong in JavaScript/HTML/CSS frontend experience, skilled in common web platforms such as React/Vue/Angular, and have good practice and understanding of common web compilation and bundling frameworks, including Webpack/Rollup/Babel/AST; - Have solid experience in implementing web applications with high performance, high availability, and excellent user experience; - Good problem solving skills and thinking patterns in web-based system design. Preferred Qualification(s) - Minimum 5 years relevant work experience from a large-scale internet business. - Experience in e-wallet and payment product development; - Agile, quick self learner, highly self-motivated with a strong sense of product ownership and creative problem solver; - Good collaborator and team player, comfortable working in a fast pace, diversified and global team environment. Job Information About Us Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content. ​ Why Join ByteDance Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day. ​ As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ Diversity & Inclusion ​ ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Category:** Engineering Product **Job Type:** Full Time **Job Location:** Bandung **Job Status:** Priority Hiring Bandung, Indonesia · Full-Time **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer who is passionate about building impactful solutions that transform education. This role requires strong skills across both front-end and back-end, with the ability to design, build, and scale applications that are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with our mission. You'll build end-to-end across our stack, working heavily with AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) — which means you'll direct that work, review it critically, and own the correctness and quality of what ships, front to back. We value adaptability, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. **Our stack:** Next.js + React (TypeScript, Tailwind) on the front end · Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI on the back end · MongoDB + Redis · Git + CI/CD · GCP. These are deliberate, AI-friendly choices, so you can move fast and still review with confidence. **Before You Apply** -------------------- This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You'll handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision — including code an AI agent drafted and you made correct. You must stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your work, and deliver reliable outputs even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback needs a fast turnaround. If you want a role that will stretch your technical range, sharpen your problem-solving, and connect your work to a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Full-Stack Development** * Design and build front-end and back-end features for web and mobile: responsive, accessible interfaces in Next.js/React, and scalable APIs and services in Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI. * Own features end-to-end — data model to UI — with sound design decisions and rigorous testing. * Work with MongoDB and Redis for reliable, performant data and state. **AI-Assisted Development & Oversight** * Direct Claude Code and other AI tools to build features fast, writing clear specs and prompts. * Review and refine AI-generated code across the stack; you're accountable for correctness, security, and maintainability — not the AI. * Set conventions and tests that keep AI output consistent and safe to ship. **Collaboration & Delivery** * Partner with product, design, and program teams to turn requirements into effective solutions. * Take part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, keep CI/CD deployments fast and safe, and provide prompt support for live systems. * Maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3+ years as a full-stack developer shipping applications in production. * **Front end:** proficiency with Next.js/React and TypeScript (Tailwind or similar). * **Back end:** strong skills in Node.js/Express and/or Python/FastAPI; comfortable with Next.js server-side code. (Depth on one end plus solid range across the rest is fine — you don't need to be an expert in everything.) * Experience with MongoDB and Redis, and sound API design. * Disciplined testing, plus Git and CI/CD. * Ability to direct AI coding tools (especially **Claude Code**) and critically review their output — strong enough to catch what the AI gets wrong. * Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently under pressure. **Bonus Points If You Have** ---------------------------- * Containerized deployments (Docker or similar). * Experience with AI/ML or data-driven applications. * Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD beyond the basics. * A real knack for prompt and workflow design with agentic coding tools. * Experience in edtech, mission-driven, or non-profit projects. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for routine work, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to build end-to-end solutions that matter and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer (Full-Time)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Description * Mengembangkan, membangun, dan memelihara aplikasi web dari sisi frontend dan backend sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis perusahaan. * Merancang, mengembangkan, dan mengoptimalkan antarmuka pengguna (UI) yang responsif, interaktif, dan mudah digunakan. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara server-side logic, API, serta integrasi dengan database dan layanan pihak ketiga. * Merancang, mengelola, dan mengoptimalkan database untuk memastikan keamanan, konsistensi, dan efisiensi pengolahan data. * Mengintegrasikan frontend dengan backend untuk memastikan seluruh fitur aplikasi berjalan dengan baik. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara RESTful API atau layanan API lainnya sesuai kebutuhan sistem. * Melakukan pengujian, debugging, dan troubleshooting untuk mengidentifikasi serta memperbaiki bug atau permasalahan teknis. * Mengoptimalkan performa, skalabilitas, keamanan, dan stabilitas aplikasi. * Melakukan deployment, pemeliharaan, serta pemantauan aplikasi pada lingkungan development, staging, dan production. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara integrasi dengan sistem eksternal, termasuk payment gateway, layanan cloud, dan aplikasi pihak ketiga jika diperlukan. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim UI/UX Designer, Product Manager, QA, dan tim terkait untuk memastikan pengembangan produk sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan spesifikasi. * Melakukan code review, menulis kode yang terstruktur, serta menerapkan standar dan best practices dalam pengembangan perangkat lunak. * Menyusun dan memelihara dokumentasi teknis, termasuk dokumentasi API, arsitektur sistem, dan alur pengembangan aplikasi. * Mengidentifikasi peluang perbaikan dan memberikan rekomendasi teknis untuk meningkatkan kualitas serta efisiensi sistem. * Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi dan menerapkan solusi yang relevan untuk mendukung pengembangan produk perusahaan. **Qualifications:** * Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman kerja sebagai Full Stack Developer atau posisi serupa. * Menguasai HTML, CSS, dan JavaScript atau TypeScript untuk pengembangan frontend. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan framework frontend seperti React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, atau framework sejenis. * Menguasai bahasa pemrograman backend seperti JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, atau bahasa lain yang relevan. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan framework backend seperti Node.js/Express.js, NestJS, Laravel, Django, atau framework sejenis. * Memahami konsep RESTful API, autentikasi, otorisasi, dan integrasi sistem. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan database relasional maupun nonrelasional, seperti MySQL, PostgreSQL, atau MongoDB. * Memahami Git dan version control untuk pengelolaan kode serta kolaborasi tim. * Memiliki pemahaman mengenai deployment aplikasi, CI/CD, serta layanan cloud menjadi nilai tambah. * Memahami prinsip keamanan aplikasi, optimasi performa, dan pengembangan sistem yang skalabel. * Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan pemecahan masalah yang baik. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan manajemen waktu yang baik. * Teliti, proaktif, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu beradaptasi dengan kebutuhan proyek. Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Full-Stack SMPP Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Full-Stack SMPP Developer** We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Full-Stack SMPP Developer to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing robust SMS gateway solutions and full-stack web applications. You will bridge the gap between complex telecom protocols and modern web interfaces, ensuring seamless, high-volume, and reliable message routing. **Key Responsibilities** * SMPP Integration & Management: Implement, configure, and maintain SMPP (Short Message Peer-to-Peer) client/server connections (v3.4/v5.0) with various SMS Centers (SMSC) and telecom aggregators. * Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and deploy scalable front-end and back-end applications that interface with our SMS gateway and core business systems. * System Optimization: Monitor and optimize database queries, API performance, and message queuing systems to handle high-throughput SMS traffic. * Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to SMPP session drops, message delivery failures, and application bugs. * Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, QA engineers, and external telecom partners to deliver reliable communication solutions. * Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while adhering to best practices in software development and version control (Git). **Mandatory Qualifications** * Education: Must be a College Graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. * SMPP Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience specifically working with the SMPP Protocol (e.g., handling SMSC connections, parsing PDUs, managing SMPP sessions, and troubleshooting delivery receipts). * Full-Stack Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of professional experience in Full-Stack Development, demonstrating proficiency in both front-end and back-end technologies. **Technical Skills & Competencies** * Backend Technologies: Proficiency in languages commonly used for SMPP and backend services (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or PHP). * Frontend Technologies: Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) and standard HTML/CSS. * SMPP Libraries: Familiarity with SMPP libraries such as Cloudhopper (Java), jSMPP, node-smpp, or Python's smpplib is highly advantageous. * Databases: Solid understanding of relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases. * APIs & Messaging: Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and message brokers/queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis). * Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and excellent communication skills. **Work Setup & Location Details** Hybrid Work Model (A mix of on-site and remote work, specific schedule to be discussed during the interview). On-Site Office: Ruko Citra 7, Jl. Peta Barat No.16 Blok A03, Desa/Kelurahan Kalideres, Kec. Kalideres, Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, Provinsi DKI Jakarta 11840 **What We Offer** * Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits (HMO). * Government-mandated benefits * A collaborative and innovative work environment. * Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth in the telecom-tech space. Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * SMPP Protocol: 1 year (Required) * Full-Stack Development: 2 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui * Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, Directus, or equivalent) — collections, access control, generated types, migrations * Testing and delivery discipline: e2e tests (Cypress or Playwright) and unit/integration tests (Vitest or Jest), Git flow, code review, working with CI * Daily use of AI development tools (Claude Code or equivalents), including configuring them for a project — context, instructions, rules, MCP/integrations — with full ownership of the quality, security, and correctness of generated code * English — B1+ ### **Leadership Attributes** * Owns the outcome — takes a task from requirement to production without waiting to be pushed, and stays accountable for the result and the area it touches * Maximally autonomous and involved — needs a goal, not step-by-step instructions, and cares how the product performs, not just whether the ticket is closed * Verifies before trusting — treats AI output, third-party responses, and your own code as unproven until tested * Structured communicator — surfaces risks, blockers, and estimate changes early, in writing, in a remote team * Knows the edge of their scope — escalates architectural and security decisions instead of improvising them * Learns from incidents — fixes the root cause, not just the symptom **Location** ============ Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours. **Benefits** ============ Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer: * **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. * **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. * **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. * **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. * **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth! **Interview Process** ===================== After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps: * Recruiter Screening (40 minutes) * Technical Interview (60 minutes) **Life at Ruby Labs** ===================== At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day. This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen. Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success. #LI-Remote

jobs.title: Marketing Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Overview** Wego is an online travel metasearch platform used by millions to find the best flights and hotel deals. We are seeking a talented, agile Marketing Automation & AI Engineer with a strong focus on Agentic AI to join our MarTech team. **Role Description** As part of the Marketing Technology (MarTech) team, you will build the next generation of marketing automation - designing and deploying autonomous AI agents that drive insights from digital campaigns and independently optimize marketing operations. You will work daily alongside the Performance Marketing team, deeply understanding their KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates) and how media platforms work, their campaign structures, auction mechanics, and APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Apple Search Ads) to ensure every system you build directly serves campaign performance goals. Unlike traditional, rigid backend data roles focused solely on static data lakes, this position requires building highly adaptable, configuration-driven automation systems. You will design architectures that allow the Performance Marketing team to quickly pivot campaign strategies, creative assets, and budget pacing without needing structural core code deployments for every minor requirement change. **Key Responsibilities** * **Campaign Creation & Optimization Automation:** Architect end-to-end automated workflows for campaign creation, audience segmentation, creative assembly, launch, and continuous optimization using AI/ML signals to drive dynamic bidding, budget pacing, and A/B testing across channels. * **AI-Driven Content Orchestration:** Engineer multi-agent systems to generate and iterate on personalized ad content (ad copy, images, videos) at scale. * **Agile Data Activation & Automation Infrastructure:** Build and maintain flexible data flows optimized for real-time marketing activation. Ensure data structures are explicitly designed for dynamic content generation and automated campaign adjustment rather than just static reporting or legacy ETL pipelines. * **Performance Marketing Collaboration:** Partner daily with the Performance Marketing team to translate KPIs and rapidly changing campaign objectives into technical configurations; ensure data integrity, API reliability, and consistent AI agent deployments across all paid channels. * **Agentic Workflow Development:** Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents using LLMs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) for automated marketing workflows. **Qualifications** **Experience & Domain Expertise** * 3+ years in performance/digital marketing analytics and marketing automation with hands-on experience in AI engineering. * Deep understanding of paid/performance marketing KPIs, how media platforms work (campaign structure, auction mechanics, targeting, measurement) and their APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok), and MMP tooling (AppsFlyer, Adjust). * Proven experience building end-to-end campaign automation systems including programmatic campaign creation, ML-driven optimization, and automated actions via ad platform APIs. **Technical Skills** * Advanced SQL and Python. * Proven experience building configuration-driven architectures or rules engines (e.g., headless CMS integrations, dynamic creative optimization tools), attribution models, and activation workflows. * Proficiency building and orchestrating AI agents using foundational LLMs; integrating LLMs and AI agents with external tools and APIs. **Soft Skills & Mindset** * Extreme flexibility and comfort with ambiguity: Understands that marketing strategies pivot quickly and intentionally designs technical solutions to accommodate fluid business requirements. * Strong product mindset: Views the marketing team as your core "users" and builds tools that empower them to self-serve safely. * Excellent communication skills to seamlessly bridge technical architectures with creative marketing strategies.
