jobs.title: Electrical Engineer R&D (Paid Internship)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Kualifikasi :** * Mahasiswa aktif atau fresh graduate jurusan Teknik Elektro, Teknik Energi Terbarukan, Teknik Fisika, atau bidang relevan. * Memiliki pemahaman dasar mengenai sistem kelistrikan AC/DC, elektronika, distribusi daya, dan konversi energi. * Memiliki ketertarikan tinggi terhadap riset dan pengembangan teknologi kelistrikan, khususnya solar panel, renewable energy, dan sistem efisiensi energi. * Memahami konsep dasar sistem panel surya (PLTS), inverter, baterai, dan sistem penyimpanan energi menjadi nilai tambah. * Mampu melakukan riset, pengumpulan data, analisis teknis, serta menyusun rekomendasi berdasarkan hasil penelitian. * Memiliki kemampuan dasar dalam melakukan perhitungan kebutuhan daya, konsumsi energi, dan estimasi efisiensi sistem kelistrikan. * Memiliki pengalaman proyek akademik, penelitian, atau tugas akhir terkait energi terbarukan maupun sistem kelistrikan menjadi nilai tambah * Siap internship selama 6 bulan **Tanggung Jawab :** * Melakukan riset terkait teknologi panel surya dan alternatif sumber energi listrik yang berpotensi diterapkan pada infrastruktur perusahaan. * Menganalisis kebutuhan konsumsi daya dan peluang efisiensi energi pada infrastruktur operasional Jinom. * Melakukan studi kelayakan awal penerapan solar panel, termasuk kebutuhan kapasitas, estimasi investasi, dan potensi penghematan biaya. * Membandingkan berbagai teknologi kelistrikan berdasarkan aspek teknis, efisiensi, keandalan, dan biaya implementasi. * Membantu penyusunan simulasi, desain konsep, atau proof of concept (PoC) sederhana berdasarkan hasil riset. * Mengidentifikasi potensi penerapan teknologi kelistrikan yang dapat mendukung efisiensi dan keberlanjutan operasional perusahaan. * Menyusun laporan riset, dokumentasi teknis, serta mempresentasikan hasil analisis dan rekomendasi kepada tim terkait. Jenis Pekerjaan: Magang Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Process Electrician Superintendent
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Overview:** The Process Electrician Superintendent role requires an in-depth understanding of project execution strategies, workforce management theories, and Process Electrician principles, with a basic knowledge of related disciplines. The Process Electrician Superintendent must be able to apply industry insights to enhance on-site productivity, provide leadership, and influence processes and policies for effective workforce governance, as well as identify and resolve technical, operational, and organizational problems that impact project outcomes. The Process Electrician Superintendent’s decisions are pivotal in ensuring that the team meets its objectives with efficiency and adherence to safety standards. These decisions should be guided by established policies, resource allocations, budget considerations, and the overarching project plan. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably. For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** * Supervise all process electrical activities in the fabrication department, ensuring that installation, maintenance, and repair work is performed in accordance with project specifications and safety standards * Enforce adherence to electrical safety regulations and best practices, conducting regular safety meetings and training to maintain a zero-incident workplace * Collaborate with project managers and other superintendents to coordinate electrical tasks with the overall project schedule, ensuring timely completion and integration with other trades * Oversee the selection, installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems, including power distribution, control systems, and instrumentation * Manage a team of process electricians, providing leadership, guidance, and support to achieve high-quality electrical work and adherence to industry standards * Monitor the use of materials and equipment, maintaining inventory control and ensuring the availability of necessary resources for project execution * Perform quality control inspections of electrical work, verifying that installations are up to code and meet operational requirements * Communicate effectively with clients, contractors, and team members to provide updates, resolve issues, and ensure project objectives are met * Own and lead the implementation, enforcement, and verification of compliance with all McDermott policies and procedures * Ensure employees understand their responsibility and authority to effectively implement the requirements of all McDermott policies and procedures * Ensure the timely completion of all mandatory training by themselves and their teams **Essential Qualifications and Education:** * Technical diploma or certification in Electrical Technology, Industrial Electricity, or a related field, with a strong background in process electrical work within a fabrication setting * Proven experience as a process electrician with a history of progression to supervisory roles, demonstrating the ability to manage teams and projects * Knowledge of electrical codes, standards, and practices, with a focus on safety and quality in electrical installations and maintenance * Experience in implementing and maintaining electrical safety protocols, with a commitment to creating a safe working environment * Leadership and team management skills, with the ability to mentor and motivate electricians to perform at their best * Organizational and planning skills, capable of managing multiple tasks and prioritizing effectively to meet project deadlines * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with a diverse range of stakeholders and convey technical information clearly * Flexibility to adapt to different project requirements and work environments, including the availability to work overtime or on shifts as needed #LI-DL1

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer (Fullstack) - 2 Job Title Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform Job Description About the Role We’re hiring for a Full-stack Engineer for Flip's newly created AI Platform team. You will be working with the technology that will support and empower our various product offerings, including but not limited to payments & transfers, lifestyle products, gaming, payment gateway, and many others. You’ll be working across both front-end and back-end components — turning ideas into impactful features that enhance user experience and business efficiency. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, fellow engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize solutions that align with our technical and business goals. You’ll also have the opportunity to continuously improve our codebase, share best practices, and explore new technologies that keep our systems robust and future ready. About Flip Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After ten years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. (e.g., Mailchimp, Figma-to-code plugins). * Familiarity with UI/UX principles and digital accessibility (WCAG) standards. jobs.title: UI-UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk or Adira Finance was established in 1990 and started its operation in 1991. Since the beginning, Adira Finance committed to be the best and foremost finance company in Indonesia. Adira Finance presents to serve various financing as of vehicles, both new or used ones. Recognize the potential, Adira Finance began to conduct initial public offering for its shares in 2004 and Bank Danamon became the majority shareholder with 75% ownership. Through some corporate actions, currently Bank Danamon owns 92.07% of Adira Finance’s shares. Adira Finance is becoming part of Temasek Holding, an investment company owned by the Government of Singapore. In 2012, Adira Finance has augmented its business activities with sharia financing. In order to provide maximum financing service, the Company begin to provide durables financing for its customers. Until 2015, Adira Finance operated 558 business networks throughout Indonesia and supported by more than 21 thousand employees, to serve 3 million customers with more than Rp40 trillion of managed receivables. Adira Finance continuously contributes to the nation and the country of Indonesia. Through its brand identity and commitment, namely “Sahabat Setia Selamanya”, Adira Finance committed to impose its mission which ends with the increment of the welfare of the Indonesian society. It is performed through the providing of various products and services according to the customers’ life cycle as well as providing beneficial experiences to the customers. **Job Description** Are you a highly skilled UI/UX Designer? Do you thrive in a collaborative team environment where you can exchange creative ideas and concepts? Your role at Adira Finance will be strategic, conceptual, and executional—leveraging design as a way of articulating possibilities, solutions and vision We are looking for a highly creative individual to join our team as a Creative Designer! As a UI/UX Designer, your responsibilities are: * Provide real innovative on-line experience and design prototypes * Illustrate design ideas using storyboards, process flows and sitemaps * Design graphic user interface elements, like menus, tabs and widgets * Collaborate with product/project manager and engineers to define and implement innovative solutions for the product direction, visuals and experience * Prepare and present rough drafts to internal teams and key stakeholders * Incorporate design into existing/developed applications * Establish and promote design guidelines, best practices and standards * Work in an Agile team where there is close collaboration with the front-end and back-end developers and in an iterative manner. * Identify and troubleshoot UX problems (e.g. responsiveness) * Conduct layout adjustments based on user feedback **Qualifications** **Who is right for the job?** * Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's Degree, Art/Design/Creative Multimedia, Computer Science/Information Technology, or equivalent. * At least 1 year(s) of working experience in the related field is **required** for this position. * Exceptional design skills, and attention to detail * Knowledge of wireframe tools (e.g. Wireframe.cc and InVision) Up-to-date knowledge of design software like Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop * Keep up-to-date with current design trends * Good knowledge of the UI/ UX methodology * Passion for creating experiences in online environments * Understanding of Agile software development * Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills **Additional Information** Note : To be considered, all applicants must submit a link to a portfolio site to https://bit.ly/2G0w9Fi

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description:** * Merancang user interface (UI) dan user experience (UX) untuk website, aplikasi, dan platform digital perusahaan. * Melakukan riset pengguna untuk memahami kebutuhan, perilaku, dan permasalahan pengguna. * Membuat user flow, wireframe, mockup, dan prototype sebagai acuan pengembangan produk digital. * Mengembangkan desain yang intuitif, menarik, responsif, dan mudah digunakan. * Melakukan usability testing serta mengevaluasi desain berdasarkan feedback pengguna. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product Manager, Developer, dan tim terkait untuk memastikan desain dapat diimplementasikan sesuai kebutuhan. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara design system serta menjaga konsistensi visual pada produk digital. * Melakukan evaluasi dan perbaikan desain secara berkala berdasarkan hasil pengujian dan kebutuhan bisnis. * Memastikan desain sesuai dengan prinsip usability, accessibility, dan responsive design. * Mengikuti perkembangan tren desain UI/UX serta menerapkan praktik terbaik dalam pengembangan produk digital. **Qualifications:** * Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 di bidang Desain Komunikasi Visual, Desain Grafis, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman sebagai UI/UX Designer menjadi nilai tambah. * Menguasai Figma atau tools desain sejenis. * Memahami prinsip UI/UX design, user-centered design, wireframing, prototyping, dan usability testing. * Memiliki kemampuan menyusun user flow, wireframe, mockup, dan prototype interaktif. * Memahami responsive design serta prinsip dasar accessibility. * Memiliki portofolio desain UI/UX yang menunjukkan proses dan hasil perancangan. * Memiliki kemampuan berpikir analitis, kreatif, dan berorientasi pada kebutuhan pengguna. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan manajemen waktu yang baik. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Product Designer** ==================== Product On-site Jakarta, Indonesia **We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;** ------------------------------------------------- ‍ enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience*‍* *As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.* **Empowering Private Markets**: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets. **Innovative Financial Ecosystem**: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services. As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally. Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us. ‍ **About The Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams. Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way. ‍ **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer * Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma * Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent * Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended * Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams. #### **In your first 6 months, you might** * Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system * Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones * Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers * Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed. ‍ **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance * A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you learned, not just final screens * At least one shipped product or feature you can talk discuss in detail * Comfortable in Figma, with a working understanding of how software gets built * Confident communicating in English, written and spoken, including explaining design decisions to non-designers * Curious and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in growing your craft alongside a senior designer. * Balances outcomes for both users and the business #### **Preferred (Nice to have)** * Experience with Jira, Confluence or product analytics tools * Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI) in your design workflow * A solid understanding of the SDLC and how a product is delivered as end-to-end working software * Prior experience in fintech, finance, or investment platforms is a plus ‍ If you are interested please send your resume to jobs@alta.exchange. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Brand Designer** ------------------ Jakarta, Indonesia Full-TimeDesign #### **Role Description** As a Brand Designer, you will be involved in creating brand identities, visual systems, packaging, communication materials, websites and digital touchpoints for our clients’ brands. You will work closely with designers, brand strategists, developers and other team members to bring ideas from concept to completion. This role is suited for someone who is strong in visual design, but also interested in strategy, user needs, business context and how brands come to life across different touchpoints. You will be expected to develop creative concepts, design brand identities, prepare presentation decks, create marketing and communication materials, support packaging and digital design, and ensure brand consistency across applications. We are looking for someone who is independent, responsive, communicative, adaptable and driven. The ideal candidate is not only strong in execution, but also confident in sharing ideas, asking thoughtful questions, proposing better ways forward and working closely with the team to push creative boundaries. We are also looking for someone who is AI native, curious about new tools and able to use AI to support research, ideation, visual exploration, content development and workflow efficiency without losing strong design judgment. #### **Responsibilities** * Create brand identity systems, visual concepts, graphic design, packaging design, website design and digital design assets for clients across different industries * Develop creative concepts based on strategy, user needs and business objectives * Translate brand strategy into meaningful and distinctive visual expressions * Design brand applications across print, digital, packaging, social media, websites and other touchpoints * Prepare presentation decks and communicate design ideas clearly to internal teams and clients * Support user research, competitor research, visual research and design exploration * Use Figma, Adobe Creative Suite and relevant design tools to create high-quality design work * Use AI tools to support research, ideation, content generation, visual exploration and workflow efficiency * Work with developers to ensure the website and digital design intent are translated clearly into execution * Manage design tasks independently and ensure timelines are met * Communicate progress, challenges and ideas clearly without waiting to be asked * Be responsive and proactive in team discussions, client communication and project coordination * Maintain brand consistency across different brand touchpoints * Push creative boundaries while ensuring the work remains strategic, relevant and practical #### **What We're Looking For** We are looking for a designer who not only makes things look good, but also thinks, questions, explores and proposes better ways forward. You should be comfortable working in a dynamic consultancy environment where every project is different. You should be curious about business, brands, users, technology, culture, and the role design plays in shaping perception and growth. You should also be open to learning and using new tools, especially AI tools, to make your creative process sharper, faster and more effective. We value designers who communicate openly and proactively. This means you should be comfortable updating the team, sharing your point of view, asking the right questions, raising challenges early and contributing actively from brief to final delivery. Most importantly, you should care about creating design that is meaningful, strategic and useful. **Requirements** * Strong portfolio in brand identity, graphic design, visual communication or related work * Good sense of typography, layout, colour, composition and visual storytelling * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign and Figma * Ability to think conceptually and translate ideas into clear visual directions * Interest in branding, business, culture, users and design strategy * Good communication skills and willingness to present ideas * Ability to work independently and collaboratively * Experience in packaging, UI/UX, motion, social media content or AI-assisted design tools will be an advantage **How to Apply** Please submit your CV and portfolio. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an on-site interview.

jobs.title: Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Welcome to IHG Hotels & Resorts** =================================== We are one of the world’s leading hospitality organisations, with a global portfolio of over 6,600 hotels and more than 375,000 colleagues. Whether your passion lies in driving commercial success, building powerful brands, creating meaningful customer connections, or delivering exceptional guest experiences, there is **Room for You at IHG**. We are looking for a **Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing** to join our leadership team at Hotel Indigo Bintan and Holiday Inn Resort Bintan. As Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing, you will provide strategic leadership and direction for the overall commercial performance of both properties. You will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximise revenue, increase market share, strengthen brand positioning, and achieve business objectives. This role requires strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and proven leadership capabilities, with the ability to identify market opportunities, build long-term business relationships, and drive sustainable revenue growth. You will lead the Sales & Marketing team, oversee key account management, develop effective marketing initiatives, and work closely with Revenue Management and Operations teams to ensure alignment with the overall business strategy. **Your Day-to-Day** * Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to achieve revenue targets, maximise market share, and strengthen the positioning of both properties. * Lead, coach, and develop the Sales & Marketing team to deliver strong commercial results and achieve individual and departmental objectives. * Drive business development across key market segments, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and other revenue-generating opportunities. * Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key accounts, corporate clients, travel agents, tour operators, media, and business partners. * Oversee the development and execution of integrated marketing, digital marketing, public relations, and promotional campaigns to enhance brand awareness and generate business. * Monitor market intelligence, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer insights to identify new opportunities and maintain a competitive advantage. * Work closely with Revenue Management to develop pricing strategies, optimise business mix, and maximise overall revenue performance. * Oversee sales forecasts, budgets, marketing expenditures, and departmental performance, ensuring effective resource allocation and return on investment. * Drive cross-property commercial initiatives and ensure consistency in sales and marketing strategies while respecting each brand's positioning and identity. * Collaborate with General Managers, Revenue Management, and Operations teams to align commercial strategies with overall business priorities. * Monitor commercial performance through regular reviews, reporting, and strategic action plans to ensure business objectives are achieved. * Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with IHG brand standards, corporate guidelines, and relevant policies. **What We Need From You** * Proven experience in hotel sales and marketing, preferably in a Director of Sales & Marketing or senior commercial leadership position. * Strong understanding of the hospitality industry, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and digital marketing segments. * Demonstrated success in developing and executing commercial strategies that deliver revenue growth, market share expansion, and strong business performance. * Proven leadership capabilities with the ability to inspire, coach, and develop high-performing teams. * Strong commercial acumen, financial understanding, and experience managing departmental budgets, forecasts, and business performance. * Excellent strategic planning, negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. * Strong knowledge of digital marketing, brand positioning, public relations, and market development strategies. * Ability to analyse market trends, interpret business data, and translate insights into actionable commercial strategies. * Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with ownership, corporate teams, General Managers, and business partners. * A strategic thinker with a proactive, innovative, and results-driven mindset. * Excellent command of English; additional language skills would be an advantage. **If you are a commercially driven leader with a passion for hospitality, strategic marketing, and developing high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you.** Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

jobs.title: ASEA E-Commerce Head
jobs.descriptionHtml: * **Position: ASEA E-Commerce Head** * **Reporting to: General Manager Opella ASEA - CHC AMEA Region** * **Primary Location: Indonesia** * **Alternate locations: Singapore or Philippines** **Locations: Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore. The appointment is intended to be locally based rather than an international relocation.** *Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.* *Our mission: to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.* *At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers.* *Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.* *Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at* *www.opella.com.* **Role Purpose** The ASEA E-Commerce Head will lead Opella’s e-commerce strategy and business across SEA, accelerating sustainable and profitable growth across marketplaces, e-retailers, social commerce, D2C and omnichannel channels. This role will be operated as a business leader and mini-GM for e-commerce business, bringing together strategy, commercial execution, platform and customer partnerships, P&L thinking, digital capability and team leadership. The role will work closely with Country GMs, Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Media and cross-functional teams to embed e-commerce into Opella’s overall growth strategy. **Key Responsibilities** **1. E-Commerce Strategy & Business Growth** * Define and lead the ASEA e-commerce strategy, translating regional priorities into differentiated market plans. * Own the e-commerce growth agenda across key ASEA markets. * Identify new growth opportunities across marketplaces, e-retail, quick commerce, social commerce and D2C. * Build clear Scale / Optimize / Stop choices across platforms, brands and markets. * Ensure e-commerce is fully integrated into country commercial and brand strategies. **2. Commercial & P&L Leadership** * Drive sustainable Net Sales, GMV, market share, margin and profitability across e-commerce. * Lead channel economics includes pricing, promotion, investment, assortment and trade spend. * Establish rigorous commercial performance management across markets and platforms. * Balance top-line acceleration with sustainable profitability and investment effectiveness. **3. Marketplace & Customer Leadership** * Develop strategic partnerships with key e-commerce platforms, e-retailers, customers and distributors. * Lead senior engagement and Joint Business Planning with platforms and e-retail partners. * Strengthening Opella’s capabilities across Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and other priority platforms. * Develop platform-specific strategies covering assortment, pricing, promotions, media, content and conversion. **4. Omnichannel & Consumer Experience** * Connect e-commerce with broader pharmacy, modern trade and omnichannel strategies. * Build seamless consumer journeys from awareness and consideration through conversion and repeat purchase. * Partner with Brand and Media teams to connect retail media, performance marketing and commerce. * Drive excellence in digital shelf, content, search, ratings and reviews, and conversion. **5. Data, Insights & Performance** * Build a strong performance culture using consumer, customer and platform data. * Establish common ASEA KPIs and dashboards covering Net Sales, GMV, market share, traffic, conversion, ROAS, basket size, repeat purchase and profitability. * Translate data into clear commercial actions and resource allocation decisions. * Strengthening Opella’s test & learn capability across markets. **6. Social Commerce & Emerging Channels** * Shape the ASEA social commerce strategy, including TikTok Shop, livestream, creators and affiliates. * Identify emerging consumer and commerce trends and translate them into scalable opportunities. * Accelerate successful market pilots across ASEA. **7. Leadership & Capability Building** * Lead, coach and develop e-commerce teams across ASEA. * Build e-commerce capabilities across Commercial, Brand and local market teams. * Create common ways of working, governance and best-practice sharing across markets. * Attract and develop high-performing digital commerce talent. * Foster an entrepreneurial culture with strong accountability for outcomes. **Experience & Knowledge** **Essential** * Proven experience in e-commerce, digital commerce, commercial or omnichannel leadership, ideally within FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Beauty, Personal Care or another consumer-led business. * Experience leading a sizeable B2C e-commerce business. * Strong commercial and P&L orientation with demonstrated accountability for growth and profitability. * Deep understanding of marketplace and e-retail business models. * Experience working with platforms such as Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and/or other major e-commerce ecosystems. * Strong understanding of pricing, promotions, digital shelf, retail media and conversion. * Proven ability to operate across functions and influence senior stakeholders. * Strong people leadership and capability-building experience. **Preferred** * Regional or multi-country Southeast Asia experience. * Experience across both developed and high-growth e-commerce markets. * Consumer healthcare, FMCG or similarly regulated consumer-category experience. * Experience building or transforming an e-commerce organization rather than only managing an established channel. * Exposure to D2C, social commerce, CRM and consumer data strategies. **Leadership Profile** * **Commercial & Finance acumen:** Treats e-commerce as a business, not simply a digital channel. * **Entrepreneurial:** Comfortable building and scaling new growth models. * **Outcome-obsessed:** Converts strategy into measurable business results. * **Consumer-led:** Understands how consumers discover, evaluate and purchase healthcare products online. * **Data-driven:** Uses insights to challenge assumptions and make faster decisions. * **Enterprise-minded:** Balances market priorities with the wider ASEA and Opella agenda. * **Influential:** Aligns senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority. * **Talent-focused:** Builds strong teams and develops e-commerce capability across the organization. ***Why us?*** At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day. **We Are Challengers.** We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things: **All In Together:** We keep each other honest and have each other's backs. **Courageous:** We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity. **Outcome-Obsessed:** We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity. **Radically Simple:** We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be. Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands. www.opella.com/en/careers

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml: Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab’s cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production. **Role Summary:** As a Marketing Specialist in ID, you'll drive user adoption of Search and AI features by bridging global innovation and local needs. Combining analytics and storytelling, you'll own campaigns, research user behaviour, and collaborate cross-functionally to optimise engagement in a fast-paced environment. Role: * Develop an insight-led Search marketing plan for the Indonesian market, identifying and prioritising key growth opportunities and feature rollouts for Search, Assistant, and AI-enabled search experiences. * Lead the launch and execution of targeted Search feature campaigns from inception to completion, ensuring all initiatives drive core user adoption and engagement metrics. * Conduct deep research into Search user behaviour, query intent trends, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic product and marketing decisions. * Apply advanced Search analytics, statistical analysis, and experimentation (A/B testing) to evaluate search feature performance, user retention, and campaign impact. * Use SQL to analyse large search datasets and user interaction patterns, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for product and marketing partners. * Collaborate closely with product, comms, regional, and in-country teams to ensure seamless execution and alignment across all initiatives. * Demonstrate strong problem-solving capabilities by developing creative and non-traditional solutions for complex, undefined problems. You: * BA/BS degree or equivalent experience * 3+ years of experience in marketing, consulting, or communications, with a proven track record of exceptional performance and high productivity. * Deep expertise in Search products, digital marketing, and performance marketing for high-growth tech products. * Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities, combined with solid project management skills and the ability to lead projects independently. * Proven track record in Search analytics, statistical analysis, user funnel analysis, and controlled experimentation (A/B testing). * Proficiency in SQL to query large search interaction datasets and uncover key insights into Search user behavior. * Exceptional adaptability, strong teamwork skills, dedication, and a positive attitude. * Able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, technology work environment and navigate ambiguity in a complex matrix organisation. * Exceptional verbal and written English, and fluent in Bahasa Indonesia, with strong communication and presentation skills Please note: due to the high volume of applications, only successful candidates will be contacted with a follow-up introduction email. If you do not receive an email from Maker Lab, your application has been unsuccessful this time around. Look out for future roles! By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your data by the Maker Lab team for the purposes of your application. Maker Lab’s cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production. **Role Summary:** As a Marketing Specialist in ID, you'll drive user adoption of Search and AI features by bridging global innovation and local needs. Combining analytics and storytelling, you'll own campaigns, research user behaviour, and collaborate cross-functionally to optimise engagement in a fast-paced environment. Role: * Develop an insight-led Search marketing plan for the Indonesian market, identifying and prioritising key growth opportunities and feature rollouts for Search, Assistant, and AI-enabled search experiences. * Lead the launch and execution of targeted Search feature campaigns from inception to completion, ensuring all initiatives drive core user adoption and engagement metrics. * Conduct deep research into Search user behaviour, query intent trends, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic product and marketing decisions. * Apply advanced Search analytics, statistical analysis, and experimentation (A/B testing) to evaluate search feature performance, user retention, and campaign impact. * Use SQL to analyse large search datasets and user interaction patterns, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for product and marketing partners. * Collaborate closely with product, comms, regional, and in-country teams to ensure seamless execution and alignment across all initiatives. * Demonstrate strong problem-solving capabilities by developing creative and non-traditional solutions for complex, undefined problems. jobs.title: Marketing Manager| 100% Remote EU
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.** At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them. If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us. **THE ROLE** ------------ We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role. You will coordinate all the marketing initiatives, create new marketing angles, offers, and landing pages, manage the creative department, and brief Facebook ads. This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in. You’ll be the glue between marketing, design, and development - turning customer insights into landing pages, funnels, and campaigns that people *actually want to click, read, and buy from*. If you love: * mixing strategy with execution * testing ideas * improving funnels * and making pretty things convert …and you’ve played with AI tools to move faster, build smarter, or test better ideas, you might be our person **WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** ------------------------ ### **Strategy & Growth Stuff** * Build and run marketing strategies that support real business goals (not just vibes). * Dig into customer research and market trends to find new growth opportunities. * Analyze what’s working (and what’s not) and turn data into smart next steps. * Come up with fresh ideas to scale our funnels and campaigns. * Manage marketing projects from idea launch improvement. ### **Creative & Content Magic** * Write copy for ads, landing pages, and funnels that sounds human and sells. * Review design work and give feedback so it looks on-brand *and* converts. * Guide the creation and optimization of ad creatives with our design team. ### **Landing Pages & Website Optimization** * QA landing pages like a detective: checking UX, flow, and functionality. * Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates. * Work closely with developers to roll out website updates and improvements. ### **Team Glue (Cross-Functional Hero)** * Be the bridge between marketing, design, and development. * Create clear briefs so everyone knows what to build and why. * Track project progress and keep stakeholders in the loop. ### **Customer Research & Insights** * Collect and analyze customer feedback and data. * Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement. * Use insights to scale sales and improve acquisition. ### **AI Tools & Smarter Execution** * Bring AI into our workflow as a competitive edge. Use GPT, image/video generators, and automation platforms to compress timelines, run more experiments, and beat our own ideas. **WHAT YOU BRING** ------------------ You’re probably someone who: * Has experience as a Marketing Manager or full-stack marketer in e-commerce. * Have hands-on experience building with AI tools - vibe coding, workflow automations, etc. * Understands digital marketing and performance marketing deeply. * Can write clear, persuasive, not-boring copy. * Knows CRO and website optimization. * Loves looking at data and asking: “What actually sells?” * Is organized and good at managing projects. * Has worked with designers and developers before. * Can manage your own time and work remotely. * Cares about customers and research. * Gets excited about e-commerce growth. **BONUS POINTS IF YOU:** ------------------------ * Have used marketing automation tools. * Know your way around heatmaps, ad managers, and analytics tools. * Enjoy experimenting, testing, and improving things nonstop. **WHY FOXELLI?** ---------------- We’re not into boring corporate marketing. We like: * smart ideas * quirky personality * strong execution * and people who take ownership You’ll have space to think, test, build, and grow with us - and actually see the impact of your work. **THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS** --------------------------- Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space. Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together. **FIXED SERVICE FEE** **€2,000 - €2,800** after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience. Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement. **PERKS & BENEFITS** * Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Hubstaff ensures transparency and fairness. * Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check. * A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously. * Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested. * A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like. * Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you. **ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS** This role is 100% remote. * Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported. * For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy. (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.) Currently, **we are hiring in** Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml: About Samara Group Samara Group is a luxury yachting company offering private yacht charters, luxury liveaboard experiences, and curated voyages across the Indonesian archipelago. Our portfolio includes Otium Yacht, Mischief Voyage, Samara Liveaboard, and Siloina Surf Charter, each offering distinctive experiences in some of Indonesia's most extraordinary destinations. We are looking for a **Senior Performance Marketing Specialist** to join our marketing team and help strengthen our digital advertising performance. About the Role We are seeking a proactive, analytical, and hands-on Senior Performance Marketing Specialist to manage and optimise our paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads. The ideal candidate has solid experience in digital advertising, understands campaign performance and conversion tracking, and can translate data into practical recommendations. You will work closely with the Marketing Director, Creative, Sales, and Web Development teams to improve campaign effectiveness, generate qualified enquiries, and support our commercial objectives. We value initiative, problem-solving, collaboration, and a willingness to continuously learn and improve. Key ResponsibilitiesPaid Advertising Management * Plan, execute, monitor, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads. * Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, placements, and bidding strategies. * Conduct A/B testing of advertising creatives, audiences, and campaign approaches. * Monitor campaign performance regularly and proactively identify opportunities for improvement. * Recommend adjustments to improve campaign efficiency and results. Campaign Performance & Lead Generation * Develop and optimise campaigns focused on generating relevant, high-quality enquiries. * Monitor key performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rates, and cost per qualified lead. * Analyse campaign performance to identify opportunities to improve lead quality and conversion. * Collaborate with Sales to understand lead quality, customer enquiries, and booking outcomes. * Recommend improvements to audience targeting, advertising creatives, and landing-page conversion performance. Tracking & Analytics * Monitor and maintain conversion tracking across Meta Ads and Google Ads. * Work with Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Tag Manager (GTM). * Identify potential tracking issues and coordinate with the Web Development team to resolve them. * Ensure campaign tracking and conversion data are accurate and reliable. * Support improvements to CRM attribution and lead tracking. Reporting & Analysis * Prepare concise weekly performance updates and monthly campaign reports. * Analyse advertising performance, campaign spend, lead generation, and conversion results. * Provide clear insights and actionable recommendations based on campaign data. * Track campaign performance against agreed objectives and budgets. * Communicate performance issues and opportunities proactively. Team Collaboration * Work closely with the Marketing Director to align advertising activities with marketing objectives. * Collaborate with the Creative team on advertising materials and content requirements. * Coordinate with Sales to evaluate lead quality and identify opportunities for improvement. * Work with the Web Development team to improve tracking and landing-page performance. * Maintain clear and timely communication on campaign progress, challenges, and recommendations. Requirements & Qualifications * Minimum **3 years of experience** in performance marketing, digital advertising, or a related role. * Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. * Good understanding of audience targeting, campaign optimisation, and lead-generation strategies. * Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Meta Pixel. * Ability to analyse campaign performance and translate data into actionable recommendations. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Proactive, organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently. * Good communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams. * Good command of written and spoken English. Nice to Have * Experience with Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and advanced conversion tracking. * Familiarity with CRM systems and lead attribution. * Experience managing advertising campaigns targeting international markets. * Experience in luxury hospitality, travel, tourism, or other high-value services. * Experience with landing-page optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO). What We Offer * Competitive salary based on experience. * The opportunity to work with a portfolio of luxury yachting and travel brands. * Hands-on ownership of paid advertising campaigns and performance optimisation. * A collaborative working environment with direct access to the Marketing Director and supporting teams. * Opportunities to develop technical skills, explore new strategies, and grow professionally. * A dynamic working environment in Bali. How to Apply Interested candidates are invited to submit: * An updated CV highlighting relevant experience. * A portfolio or examples of previous Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns, if available. * A brief overview of campaign results or achievements they are proud of. **Join Samara Group and help us create meaningful connections between our brands and travellers around the world.** Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales - Group Account Manager (Indonesia)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary Imagine what you could do here. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it! Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. Our sales team, is in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers. We are seeking a Group Account Manager to join our team based in Jakarta. Description A unique opportunity exists for an extraordinary individual to contribute to the account management of one of our biggest partners in South East Asia. Through a deep understanding of the country’s customer and channel landscapes, the Group Account Manager will lead a team of Account Managers to collaborate with our partner to develop strategic opportunities resulting in distinctive customer experiences driven growth. The role also plays a pivotal role in leading execution of local and regional programs at assigned partner. Minimum Qualifications * At least 15 years of sales and marketing experience in Indonesia, accountable for revenue outcome, preferably in MNC Technology and or FMCG * Successful experience in managing complex business environment with more than one business partners/customers and building tailor made solutions * Demonstrated superior communication, relationship building, influencing in both English and Bahasa Indonesia * Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity with integrity * Positive and proactive personality that can problem solve * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience Preferred Qualifications * People leadership experience * Proficiency in Apple products and services * Master’s degree or equivalent experience At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong. Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.title: Senior Software Automation Quality Assurance
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** * Work with Product Managers, Dev team, and UI/UX team in understanding the product, domain, and various features. * Review quality specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback. * Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases/scenario ensuring high-quality software delivery. * Estimate and prioritize testing activities. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the highest level of product quality. * Conduct quality assurance and troubleshoot any errors. * Analyze complex software systems and collaborate with others to improve the overall design, testability, and quality. * Ensure all tests and procedures meet company and industry standards. * Report, track, and monitor defects/bugs. **Requirements** * Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes. * Good analytical thinking (analyze logs and API responses, analyze bugs) * Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. * Excellent communication and team collaboration skills. * Experience with Agile methodologies, including sprints and retrospective. * Experience with Automation testing * Proficiency in testing Web Apps, Mobile Apps (iOS & Android apps), and API * Familiarity with testing tools such as QASEio, Postman * Familiarity with automation tools such Playwright, K6 is a plus * Understanding of database concepts and queries (MySQL) is a plus. * Experience with performance and/or security testing is a plus. * Experience in development software process, preferably in Health sectors is a plus. * Able to work from office (WFO Bandung) **About PT Infokes Indonesia** PT Infokes Indonesia merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak dibidang layanan sistem informasi kesehatan yang berdiri sejak 2007. jobs.title: QA Project and Data Management (SPX)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Department Operations LevelEntry Level LocationBangkok The Operation teams at Shopee covers the operational end-to-end process, from when the buyer searches for a product listed on the Shopee platform, to the moment the buyer receives the products. The team analyses and monitors operational KPIs across the region and conducts root cause analysis when operation performance fluctuates. The Operations team comprises Customer Service, Payment, Listings, Warehouse, Logistics, Seller Operations and Fraud. Job Description: The Associate will be responsible for driving key QA projects and managing data workflows to improve compliance, efficiency, and audit accuracy across SPX operations. This role combines project management, stakeholder coordination, and data analysis to ensure smooth execution of QA initiatives and to provide actionable insights to leadership. * Lead and support different projects. Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders (Ops, BI, Product, Costing, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth execution of the initiatives * Conduct deep-dive data analysis to identify non-compliance trends, operational inefficiencies, and potential fraud cases * Provide data-backed recommendations to improve frameworks, SOPs, and training * Prepare regular reports and insights for management on the performance metrics, compliance trends, and initiative progress * Support audit design and automation efforts to reduce manual work and increase audit accuracy * Conduct site visits to validate on ground practices and identify gaps * Act as a subject matter expert for the team’s data and processes, supporting continuous improvement Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or related fields * Minimum 2–4 years of experience in operations, data analysis, or project management * Strong skills in GSheet/Excel and SQL * Experience in data cleaning, root cause analysis, and translating raw data into actionable insights * Strong project management skills: able to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with tight timelines * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both in Thai and English * Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently * Willingness to conduct occasional on-site visits to hubs or warehouses

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Description** --------------- As a **Project Engineer (Mechanical, Packages & Piping)**, you will contribute to the coordination and delivery of mechanical, package and piping engineering activities within project teams. **Your main responsibilities will be:** * Lead the preparation and review of Material Requisitions / Technical Requirement for purchase requisition. * Technical Bid Evaluations (TBE) * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams (process, piping, instrument, automation, electrical, procurement, QA/QC) and vendors. * Follow company procedures as defined in the QA/QC Manual * Support fabrication, inspection, and testing activities (FAT, SAT, inspections) * Provide technical support during construction, installation, and commissioning phases * Prepare and/or coordinate any work procedures that are deemed necessary for manufacturing, handling, assembling, or lifting of the equipment according to client requirement. * Review and resolve technical queries (TQs), NCRs, and deviations at any stage of the project. * Ensure proper documentation and data management throughout the project lifecycle, including installation, commissioning, start-up, operation and maintenance documentation. * Prepare notice at change (NOC) to fabricator via Engineering Manager. * Execute any work related to skills and experience for the Project. **Requirement:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering * Minimum 5 years of experience in oil & gas, petrochemical, or EPC projects * Fluent in English * Experience in vendor management and technical bid evaluations * Familiar with inspection and testing requirements * Experience working in project environments (FEED, EPC, EPCIC) * Good coordination and communication skills

jobs.title: Advanced Project Manager for Installation
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description Summary** =========================== The Advanced Project Manager Installation (PMI) is part of Healthcare Project Management (HPM), responsible for managing wing to wing projects of GE Healthcare (GEHC) business, owns the project management and implementation process for GEHC Diagnostic Imaging, including sales order review, customer meeting, project planning, design/layout, contractor interface, submission of documentation, issue resolution, GE resources coordination which includes product shipping logistics, installation and training. GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. **Job Description** =================== **Roles and Responsibilities** * Drive customer satisfaction and process productivity from project feasibility study until project closure. The PMI is responsible for the implementation of GE Healthcare products, services, and site preparation, ensuring that installations & trainings are completed in a timely and quality manner in accordance with defined global standards, milestones and customer satisfaction matrix. * Deliver the project and manage contractors and 3rd parties to comply with GE QA and EHS requirement. * Act as the primary liaison between GE, and the GE customer team. work closely with customers facility and General Contractors * Identify, escalate, and resolve issues, which might affect customer satisfaction and GE operational targets. * Adapt a proactive approach to identify risks to project success and create and maintain a project risk log; develop effective action plans for resolution as early as possible. * Work cross functionally with sales and services teams while owning the project management and implementation process for GEHC Diagnostic Imaging. * Additional and ad hoc projects and tasks assigned by manager. * Participate in process improvement initiatives regionally and globally. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent technical field experience, majoring in BioMedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronic Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related field. * 5 years experience in cross-functional for project integration, sale and service support. * Strong project management skills are required. * Knowledge in construction field (civil, structural, architectural, electrical and HVAC) with local regulation and global standard codes is preferred. * Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple priorities to meet scheduled completion dates, execute multiple commitments within the constraints of environment and customer expectations. * Resourcefulness, commitment, interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills. * Must have a valid driver's license. * Must be willing and able to travel regularly, flexible schedule and including overnight when necessary. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Office Applications. **Desired Characteristics** * Act as a project manager for installation. * Construction field experience for hospital construction such as civil work, structural, HVAC and clean room is desirable. * Multitasking abilities to drive critical issues simultaneously. * Independently lead a customer through all aspects of design and requirements. * Experience in managing people and tasks. * Experience working with cross functional teams. **Inclusion and Diversity** GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity. Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support. **Additional Information** ========================== **Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Microsoft AI, Copilot, Power Platform & Azure Specialists — Remote Contract Opportunities** **Remote | Contract / Project-Based | International Client Projects** Vurke is expanding its global technology-delivery network and is inviting experienced Microsoft professionals to join our talent community for **current and upcoming remote implementation projects** with Microsoft partners, systems integrators, consulting firms and enterprise clients. We are looking for professionals who have **hands-on implementation experience** across Microsoft AI, Copilot, Power Platform, Azure AI, Microsoft Fabric, integration, security, governance, adoption and enterprise automation. This is not one single role. We are currently building delivery capacity across the following specialist areas: 1. **QA / Business Analyst — Microsoft AI & Power Platform** 2. **Microsoft Integration Developer** 3. **Microsoft AI Solution Architect** 4. **Power Platform Architect** 5. **AI / Agent Engineer — Microsoft Ecosystem** 6. **Azure OpenAI Engineer** 7. **Azure AI Engineer** 8. **Copilot Studio Developer** 9. **Power Automate Developer** 10. **Power Platform Developer** 11. **Microsoft AI & Power Platform Business Analyst** **What kind of opportunities are available?** Vurke specialists may work: * As part of a **Vurke delivery team** * As an extension of a **Microsoft partner or systems integrator** * Directly within an enterprise client project under an agreed delivery model * On short-term or longer-term **remote contract assignments** * On international engagements supporting clients in **North America, the United Kingdom and Europe** Vurke is building a technically assessed global talent network focused on real implementation and delivery work—not simply traditional recruitment. **Who should apply?** We want to hear from experienced professionals who can demonstrate: * Real production implementation experience * Strong Microsoft technical or functional expertise * Experience working with enterprise customers or delivery teams * Strong written and spoken English * Ability to work independently in distributed teams * Ability to clearly explain the projects you personally delivered * Availability for remote contract work * Where required, partial overlap with **US, UK or European business hours** Microsoft certifications are valuable, but **practical implementation experience matters more than certification alone**. **How the Vurke process works** Rather than applying separately to multiple job advertisements, you can join Vurke once and create your professional profile. **Step 1 — Create your Vurke profile** Register on the Vurke talent portal. **Step 2 — Upload your CV** Provide a current CV that clearly shows your Microsoft technologies, projects, responsibilities and delivery experience. **Step 3 — Select the role or roles that best match your skills** Choose the opportunities most relevant to your background. **Step 4 — Profile review and matching** Vurke reviews your experience and may use technology-assisted matching to identify suitable roles and projects. **Step 5 — Technical assessment and interview** Shortlisted professionals may be invited to a technical assessment and/or client interview. **Step 6 — Project opportunities** Successful specialists become part of the Vurke talent network and may be considered for suitable current and future international client assignments. Joining the Vurke talent network does not guarantee an immediate project assignment. Opportunities depend on live client requirements, technical fit, availability, time-zone compatibility and commercial agreement. **Why join the Vurke Talent Network?** * **Remote international contract opportunities** * Exposure to projects across **Microsoft AI, Copilot, Azure and Power Platform** * Opportunities with Microsoft partners, technology consultancies and enterprise customers * Project-based work without being limited to one geography * One professional profile that can be considered for multiple relevant opportunities * Technical assessment designed to identify strong delivery professionals * Future matching against new Vurke client requirements * Opportunity to build experience across international technology projects **Apply now** If your background fits **any of the roles above**, create your Vurke profile, upload your CV and select the opportunity most relevant to you: **Apply here:** **https://app.vurke.io/jobs** **Create your Vurke profile once. Be considered for multiple global technology projects.** Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sales - Enterprise Strategic Accounts Manager (Indonesia)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. Apple’s Sales organization generates the revenue needed to fuel our ongoing development of products and services. This in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. Our sales team, is in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers. We are here to help enterprise businesses transform the way people work— while growing top-line revenue for Apple. To realize this goal, we gain deep understandings of the businesses we manage—at all levels from tactical to strategic. We create a vision that can inspire customers to transform using Apple products. We collaborate closely with internal and external partners to create plans for solutions and new use cases, and then we help drive execution of the solution. Description - Advise on business, digital and workplace transformation solutions with strategic large customers together with our partners. - Develop account plans aligned with Enterprises’ and Government strategies, assess their progress and guide them on the journey of transformation, while growing and expanding adoption of the Apple platform and ecosystem. - Responsible for the creation, development and indirect orchestration of key industry sales plays within our customers. - Effectively execute joint account plans by cross-functionally partnering and Strategic partners, driving refresh, expansion and net new platform opportunities. - Identify and create new opportunities driving sales actions on refresh and net new platform opportunities. - Look to create lighthouse references which we can replicate and scale, leveraging success stories that can be told across industry. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. * 10 years of proven sales experience in Indonesia, preferably in capacity with background from IT Software/Services/Hardware * You have consultative selling experience in business transformation solutions for large enterprises. In your experience, you’ve balanced delivering on short-term goals, while creating sustainable value for customers, and demand for the future. Or you bring proven experience as an Account Executive for large Enterprises. * Demonstrated superior communication, relationship building, influencing in both English and Bahasa Indonesia Preferred Qualifications * Master’s degree or equivalent experience * You’re an expert at presenting and handling pressure. You simplify complex information and engage audiences. You empower others to learn and share your passion for the Apple story. When challenged, you share your deep knowledge of hardware, software, and services integration. * Apple prioritizes integrity, honesty, and accountability in all its products and business practices. You’re a trusted advisor who upholds Apple’s values and ensures its best interests are served. * You deeply understand customer needs, challenges, and concerns, enabling you to exceed customer expectations.
