jobs.title: Sales - Technology Strategist, Strategic Accounts, Indonesia
jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary The people here don’t just build products — they create the kind of technology and experiences that can change entire industries. It is the diversity of our people and their ideas that drives the innovation behind everything we do. Join us and help leave the world better than we found it. At Apple we work with some of the most ambitious organizations in the world. We help customers rethink how their people work, how technology can improve their business, and how our platforms and ecosystem can become part of that journey. The Technology Strategist is a trusted technical advisor to some of Apple’s most strategic enterprise customers in Southeast Asia. You will work with business and technology leaders to turn organizational ambition into a clear technical vision, architecture, and adoption roadmap. The role combines enterprise architecture, executive advisory, and hands-on technical leadership. You will help customers understand emerging technologies, simplify complex decisions, modernize their technology environments, and create secure, scalable experiences with Apple at their core. Description Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and senior business leaders, becoming a strategic advisor on technology and innovation. Help customers define a multi-year technical vision that connects their business ambition with their enterprise architecture, operating model, workforce strategy, and investment priorities. Assess the customer’s current technology landscape across identity, security, device management, networking, cloud services, applications, data, AI, and support operations. Translate that assessment into a practical roadmap, identifying architectural dependencies, integration requirements, technical debt, security considerations, and opportunities for simplification. Develop reference architectures and integration patterns for Apple platforms within complex, heterogeneous enterprise environments. Apply well-architected principles across security and privacy, reliability and resilience, operational excellence, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. Help customers rationalize their technology and application portfolios, understand architectural trade-offs, and make informed decisions based on business value, risk, user experience, and total cost of ownership. Lead executive briefings, technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, and design reviews. Demystify complex and emerging technologies—including AI—and explain their implications clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with Apple sales, engineering, product, security, services, and partner teams to remove technical barriers and move customers from vision to scaled adoption. Maintain a clear technical account plan with agreed priorities, milestones, success measures, risks, and owners. Represent the voice of the customer within Apple, providing insight into enterprise requirements, technology trends, and opportunities for innovation. What success looks like: - Customers have an agreed technical vision and a practical roadmap connected to their business priorities. - Executive ambition is translated into secure, scalable, and well-architected technical decisions. - Technical barriers are identified early and resolved through clear ownership and cross-functional collaboration. - Demonstrations and pilots lead to measurable adoption at scale. - Apple becomes a trusted part of the customer’s broader enterprise technology strategy. Minimum Qualifications * Strong technical depth across enterprise architecture, cloud and hybrid environments, identity and access management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, networking, application integration, and lifecycle operations. * Strong knowledge of identity and security concepts, including federation, SSO, MFA, conditional access, Zero Trust, PKI and certificates, endpoint security, data protection, and security governance. * Experience designing solutions that integrate devices and platforms with identity providers, MDM or UEM platforms, security tools, cloud services, SaaS applications, APIs, and line-of-business systems. * Strong consultative skills and the ability to uncover customer needs, challenge assumptions constructively, and connect technology decisions to business outcomes. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex technology understandable without oversimplifying it. * Confidence engaging senior executives while maintaining credibility with architects, security teams, engineers, and operations teams. * Ability to influence across complex organizations and coordinate multiple internal, customer, and partner stakeholders. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications * Experience deploying and integrating Apple platforms in large enterprise environments. * Knowledge of macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Apple Business Manager, automated device enrollment, declarative device management, Platform SSO, and Apple platform security. * Enterprise architecture, cloud, identity, security, or device-management certifications. * Experience working in regulated industries or complex multinational organizations. * Understanding of AI architectures, including cloud, hybrid, private, and on-device approaches. * Experience developing business cases using adoption outcomes, risk reduction, employee experience, and total economic impact. At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong. Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.title: Officer Account Executive-Financial Line
jobs.descriptionHtml: **EMPOWERING PEOPLE TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE** At Howden, we employ talent individuals and empower them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers. The entrepreneurial atmosphere is on of the biggest reason people love to work for us. We are a leading independent, global insurance brokers but have a noticeably flat hierarchy. It doesn't matter how junior or senior, anyone with good idea will be heard. This means our employees can shape their own career paths and determine their own success. This atmosphere attracts the brightest talent in the market. If that includes you, get in touch. Roles & Responsibilities 1. Maintains a positive attitude that promotes team work within the department and a favorable image of the company. 2. Prospecting, qualifying opportunities, initiate contact, and develop client relationships. 3. Proactively build a sustainable pipeline, create quality presentations, proposals and manage the sales cycle. 4. Maintains existing client’s records and organizes clients’ file. 5. Prepares invoices for clients (Reinsurance basis) 6. Coordinate claims after getting claim information from clients and from other team members. 7. Keeps clients/other team members informed of claim status on daily/weekly basis depending on the seriousness or urgency incidents. 8. Prepares monthly, quarterly and annual reports as required. 9. Ensures other assigned tasks to be carried out accurately and in a timely manner. 10. Checks accuracy and timeliness of policy from Insurer/Reinsurer to clients or Cedant 11. Checks accuracy of commission and prepares money remittance with Finance and Account for both Reinsurance and Direct basis. 12. Weekly/Monthly updates on FinLines account; i.e. weekly check-list update. 13. Deliver effective sales presentations and value propositions. 14. Close sales and develop long-term strategic relationships with customers. 15. Pro-actively develop new channels to market. Coordinate marketing events, seminars and road-shows. 16. Develop and maintain annual sales plans that support the quarterly. Job Specification * Education minimum Bachelor’s degree, Law, Economic, Account or Insurance * Special Product (FinLines, D&O,Cyber,PI,SPPI,Product Recall and Trade Dept Insurance/Reinsurance) with hard experience * Commitment and dedicate in job, be able to travel on business trip (local & international) * Good communication skills possess team group co-operation and higher sense of responsibility. * Being team player, energetic, well organized, and able to work under pressure

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location:** Jakarta **Employment Type:** Full-time **About Prodata** Prodata is an Indonesian IT solutions and technology distribution company, supporting enterprise customers and business partners with technology solutions and professional services. **About the Role** We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Manager to lead strategic enterprise accounts, develop major business opportunities, and drive significant revenue growth. This is a senior commercial leadership role for someone who can build executive-level relationships, lead complex sales opportunities, mobilize cross-functional teams, and convert strategic opportunities into successful business outcomes. The EAM will be supported by one or more dedicated Business Development Officers (BDOs), whom they are expected to guide and develop in generating qualified enterprise opportunities. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop strategic enterprise accounts and build relationships with senior decision-makers. * Create and lead high-value business opportunities, including competitive deals. * Direct and coach dedicated BDOs to identify enterprise prospects, reach key stakeholders, and secure qualified customer meetings. * Mobilize Presales, technology principals, business partners, and Prodata management to strengthen customer confidence and win projects. * Lead solution validation, demonstrations, POCs, negotiations, and deal closure. * Maintain customer relationships beyond PO issuance, monitor partner-delivered implementation progress, and ensure customer concerns are addressed. * Coordinate with Partners and internal teams on delivery commitments, commercial follow-ups, and account growth. * Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across solution areas. **Requirements** * **Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B enterprise sales, strategic account management, or business development.** * Experience in ICT, technology solutions, system integration, or IT distribution is strongly preferred. * Proven track record in developing new enterprise opportunities and closing major business deals. * Comfortable engaging Directors, VPs, IT leaders, and senior business stakeholders. * Strong capability in strategic selling, negotiation, pipeline management, and team coordination. * Able to lead and mobilize Business Development Officers, Presales, partners, and internal teams. * Commercially minded, accountable, persistent, and results-oriented. * Good communication and presentation skills; business-level English is preferred. **We are looking for a candidat who can create opportunities, lead teams, win major projects, protect customer relationships, and grow strategic accounts.** Interested candidates may submit their updated CV and relevant sales achievements awards. jobs.title: Sales Manager (Corporate Segment)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** **Mercure Jakarta Gatot Subroto** Novelty among the top-notch properties of south Jakarta. Conveniently located in the golden triangle area of business, Gatot Subroto. Accessible via Jl. Gatot Subroto and Jl. Kapten Tendean, with direct access to Jakarta inner ring road highway, 10 minutes to Whoosh Halim Station, close to diplomatic establishments and only 35 minutes drive from Soekarno Hatta International Airport. Providing 403 modern and superbly designed rooms, overlooking the glamorous urban scenery, ensuring comfort and serenity. Beyond its prime location, city views, and modern facilities, the hotel is committed to sustainability through its partnership with Green Key. It supports eco-friendly practices in water, energy, waste, cleaning, and sustainability education. **Job Description** To lead, develop, and maximize business opportunities within the corporate segment by establishing strong relationships with local and multinational companies, corporate organizations, and business partners. Responsible for developing and implementing effective sales strategies, managing key corporate accounts, generating new business, and achieving revenue targets to maximize the hotel's overall business performance. **Key Responsibilities** A. Sales Strategy & Business Development * Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the corporate segment. * Identify and explore new business opportunities from local companies, multinational corporations, corporate offices, and business organizations. * Develop market penetration strategies to increase the hotel's market share within the corporate segment. * Promote hotel products and services, including room accommodation, corporate rates, meeting packages, banquet facilities, catering, and other hotel offerings. * Conduct regular sales calls, client visits, business presentations, networking activities, and corporate meetings to generate new business. * Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and business opportunities to strengthen the hotel's competitive position. * Develop strategic partnerships with corporate clients to secure long-term business opportunities. B. Corporate Account Management & Client Relationship * Establish, maintain, and strengthen relationships with key corporate accounts and decision-makers. * Manage and develop strategic corporate accounts to maximize revenue production and business opportunities. * Conduct regular account reviews to evaluate business performance and identify opportunities for account growth. * Understand corporate clients' business requirements and provide customized hotel solutions. * Lead corporate rate negotiations, prepare business agreements, and ensure contracts are aligned with hotel policies and revenue strategies. * Handle key client inquiries, negotiations, and escalated complaints professionally. * Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, account retention, and repeat business. C. Revenue Management & Sales Performance * Achieve and exceed assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the corporate segment. * Monitor corporate account production, room night contribution, average room rates, and overall revenue performance. * Work closely with the Revenue Management team to establish competitive corporate rates and optimize business opportunities. * Identify opportunities to increase room revenue, meeting room utilization, banquet revenue, and other hotel revenue streams. * Prepare accurate sales forecasts, revenue projections, and business development action plans. * Monitor sales performance against targets and implement corrective actions when necessary. * Ensure an appropriate balance between business volume, room rates, and overall profitability. D. Sales Team Leadership & Development * Lead, guide, and supervise the corporate sales team to ensure the achievement of individual and departmental sales targets. * Assign sales accounts, business development activities, and performance objectives to team members. * Monitor and evaluate team performance through regular sales meetings, account reviews, and performance discussions. * Provide coaching, guidance, and support to Assistant Sales Managers and Sales Executives to improve sales effectiveness. * Encourage teamwork, accountability, and continuous professional development within the sales team. * Ensure team members maintain updated account information, sales pipelines, and activity reports. E. Coordination & Administration * Coordinate with the Director of Sales, Revenue Management, Reservations, Front Office, Food & Beverage, and Banquet teams to ensure effective sales execution and service delivery. * Ensure corporate contracts, rate agreements, proposals, and quotations are prepared accurately and professionally. * Maintain updated corporate account databases, sales pipelines, and account production records in the hotel's sales system. * Prepare and submit regular sales performance reports, forecasts, market intelligence, and business development updates. * Participate in departmental meetings and contribute to the hotel's overall commercial strategy. * Ensure all sales activities comply with hotel policies, Accor standards, and established procedures. F. Customer Experience & Brand Representation * Ensure corporate clients receive professional and consistent service throughout their business engagement with the hotel. * Represent the hotel professionally during corporate meetings, networking events, trade shows, and business functions. * Promote Accor brand standards, hotel facilities, and loyalty programs to corporate clients. * Build a positive hotel image and strengthen the hotel's reputation within the corporate business community. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. * Minimum 1-2 years of experience in hotel sales, preferably in a managerial or supervisory position handling corporate accounts. * Strong knowledge of the corporate market, including local companies, multinational corporations, and business organizations. * Proven track record in achieving sales targets and developing strategic corporate accounts. * Strong network and established relationships with corporate clients and business decision-makers. * Good understanding of hotel revenue management, corporate rate structures, and account production analysis. * Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. * Good command of written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia. * Proficient in Microsoft Office and hotel sales management systems. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities. * Results-oriented, proactive, strategic, and able to work under pressure. **Additional Information** Diversity & Inclusion for Accor means welcoming each and everyone and respecting their differences by giving priority only to qualities and skills in extending employment and development opportunities. Our ambition is to provide meaningful employment, a warm and welcoming culture, excellent working conditions and to promote the development of all people, including those with disabilities. When applying, do not hesitate to let us know of any specific needs you may have so that we can take them into consideration.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Additional Information** **Job Number**26143977 **Job Category**Finance & Accounting **Location**Pantai Wae Rana, Labuan Bajo East 86763, Indonesia **Schedule**Full Time **Located Remotely?**N **Position Type** Management **JOB SUMMARY** Functions as the property’s strategic financial business leader. The position champions, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees. The position provides the financial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment. In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand’s business strategy and focuses on the execution of financial activities and the delivery of desirable financial results. **CANDIDATE PROFILE** **Education and Experience** * 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 3 years experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area. OR * Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 1 year experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area. **CORE WORK ACTIVITIES** **Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making** * Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc. * Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans. * Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales. * Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning. * Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts. * Thinks creatively and practically to develop, execute and implement new business plans * Creates the annual operating budget for the property. * Provides analytical support during budget reviews to identify cost saving and productivity opportunities for property managers. * Implements a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks. * Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability. * Analyzes financial data and market trends. * Leads the development and implementation of a comprehensive annual business plan which is aligned with the company’s and brand’s strategic direction. * Provides on going analytical support by monitoring the operating department’s actual and projected sales. * Produces accurate forecasts that enable operations to react to changes in the business. **Leading Finance Teams** * Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example. * Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner. * Leverages strong functional leadership and communication skills to influence the executive team, the property's strategies and to lead own team. * Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes. * Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members and other departments managers' clear accountability backed by appropriate authority. * Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to standard operating procedures. **Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders** * Attends meetings and communicating with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus. * Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.). * Advises the GM and executive committee on existing and evolving operating/financial issues. * Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors. * Demonstrates an understanding of cash flow and owner priorities. * Manages communication with owners in an effective manner. * Manages property working capital and cash flow in accordance with brand standard operating procedures and owner requirements. * Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team. **Developing and Maintaining Finance Goals** * Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately. * Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued. * Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines. * Develops and supports achievement of performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc. * Improves profit growth in operating departments. * Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy. * Monitor the purchasing process as applicable. **Managing Projects and Policies** * Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc. * Reconciles balance sheet to ensure account balances are supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with standard operating procedures. * Ensures that the P&L is accurate (e.g., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts). * Ensures compliance with management contract and reporting requirements. * Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures. * Ensures compliance with standard operating procedures. **Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities** * Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations. * Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently. * Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program. * Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job. * Creates appropriate development plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities. * Conduct performance review process for employees. * Participates in hiring activities as appropriate. *At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.* The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts, with over 120 properties in more than 35 countries, offers the promise of authentic experiences that evoke lasting, treasured memories. Our more than 100 years of experience, beginning in 1906 under the Italian CIGA brand – a collection of Europe's most celebrated and iconic properties – serves as a solid foundation as we continuously evolve to exceed the desires of the luxury traveler. From legendary palaces and remote retreats to timeless modern classics, each luxury hotel and resort is a unique and cherished expression of its locale – a portal to the destination’s cultural charms and treasures. jobs.title: Facilities Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary Apple is now seeking an extraordinary Facilities Manager to support the growing team in Indonesia. The Facilities Manager is the culmination of all the skills and resources of a validated facility professional with additional cross-functional administration expertise and exceptional customer experience skills. As a Facilities Manager, you will hold a strong emphasis on running site operations critical to ensuring consistent delivery and the highest performance levels for Soft & Hard Services. You will have the ability to harmonize with Apple corporate business functions & customers at all levels and provide multiple structured and/or ad-hoc, timely and accurate status reports. Description Responsible for the delivery, management, and maintenance of services within offices and academies in Indonesia, including: - Hands-on provision of site Soft & Hard Services - Collaborating with Apple's LOB, RE&D and their nominated internal/external vendors/partners - Input to in-GEO OPEX planning and budgets - Handle Places commercial obligations, e.g., Lease, Utility & Vendor payments - Drive consistency in Places site services and resources as directed - Create and sustain Best Practices for the Facility Team - Run single to multiple, simple to complex Facility initiatives, programs, and projects - Adherence to the use of established protocols, tools & processes - Follow up with Apple customers on site services delivery tracking, issues, risks, and results - Ensure vendors' compliance with agreed SLAs and KPIs - Implement tools, standards, policies, guidelines, and processes - Input on Facility Management improvement programs - Advising and driving improvement changes in Places Facility Management services at the Site level - Support site OH&S compliance - Manage office occupancy report and space planning Minimum Qualifications * 3-5 years of experience in Facility Management or related roles in the high-end corporate office environment * Degree qualified in related fields * Contract/Operations management experience * Must have professional fluency in written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English Preferred Qualifications * Experience with space management/churn project management an advantage * IFMA certification desirable but not required * Passionate about customer services and end-user experience * Self-starter and capable individual contributor * Ability to connect with dispersed internal/external teams * Excellent communication and presentation skills At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong. Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.title: Director of Food & Beverage
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Additional Information** **Job Number**26144457 **Job Category**Food and Beverage & Culinary **Location**Jalan Embong Malang 25-31, Surabaya East 60261, Indonesia **Schedule**Full Time **Located Remotely?**N **Position Type** Management **JOB SUMMARY** Functions as the strategic business leader of the property’s food and beverage/culinary operation, including Restaurants/Bars, Room Service and Banquets/Catering, where applicable. Position oversees the development and implementation of departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures the food and beverage/culinary operation meets the brand’s target customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, and focuses on growing revenues and maximizing the financial performance of the department. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment. **CANDIDATE PROFILE** **Education and Experience** * High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, event management, or related professional area. OR * 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, event management, or related professional area. **Skills and Knowledge** * **Customer and Personal Service** - Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction. * **Management of Financial Resources** - Determining how money will be spent to get the work done, and accounting for these expenditures. * **Administration and Management -** Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, human resources modeling, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources. * **Applied Business Knowledge** - Understanding market dynamics, enterprise level objectives and important aspects of the company’s business to accurately diagnose strengths and weaknesses, anticipate opportunities and risks, identify issues, and develop strategies and plans. Aligning individual and team actions with strategies and plans to drive business results. * **Management of Material Resources** - Obtaining and seeing to the appropriate use of equipment, facilities, and materials needed to do certain work. **CORE WORK ACTIVITIES** **Developing and Maintaining Food and Beverage/Culinary Goals** * Sets expectations and holds food and beverage leadership team accountable for demonstrating desired service behaviors. * Reviews financial reports and statements to determine how Food and Beverage is performing against budget. * Makes recommendations for CAPEX funding of food and beverage equipment and renovations in accordance with brand business strategy. * Works with food and beverage leadership team to determine areas of concern and develops strategies to improve the department’s financial performance. * Establishes challenging, realistic and obtainable goals to guide operation and performance. * Strives to improve service performance. **Developing and Maintaining Budgets** * Develops and manages Food and Beverage budget. * Monitors the department’s actual and projected sales to ensure revenue goals are met or exceeded and opportunities are identified and addressed. * Ensures cash control and liquor control policies are in place in food & beverage areas and followed by all related employees. * Focuses on maintaining profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction. **Leading Food and Beverage/Culinary Team** * Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example. * Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. * Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc. * Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors. * Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc. * Identifies opportunities to increase profits and create value by challenging existing processes, encouraging innovation and driving necessary change. * Ensures that regular, on-going communication occurs in all areas of food and beverage (e.g., pre-meal briefings, staff meetings, culinary team). * Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with direct reports and entire food & beverage team. Ensures direct reports do the same for their team. * Develops a food and beverage operating strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution. * Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills. * Stays aware of market trends and introduces new food and beverage products to meet or exceed customer expectations, generate increased revenue and ensure a competitive position in the market. **Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service** * Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention. * Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed. * Reviews findings from comment cards and guest satisfaction results with F& B team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken. * Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement. * Empowers employees to provide excellent guest service. * Estimates cost and benefit ratio, maintaining balance between profit and service satisfaction. * Shares plans to take corrective action based on comment cards and guest satisfaction results with property leadership. **Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities** * Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance. * Coaches and supports food & beverage leadership team to effectively manage wages, food & beverage cost and controllable expenses (e.g., restaurant supplies, uniforms, etc.). * Hires food & beverage leadership team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation. * Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance. * Ensures that expectations and objectives are clearly communicated to subordinates; subordinates are also open to raise questions and/or concerns. * Brings issues to the attention of Human Resources as necessary. * Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably. * Coaches team by providing specific feedback to improve performance. **Additional Responsibilities** * Informs and/or update the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner. * Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person. * Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems. * Estimate food, liquor, wine, and other beverage consumption in order to anticipate amounts to be purchased or requisitioned. * Order and purchase equipment and supplies. *At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.* When you join the Sheraton family, you become a member of its global community. We’ve been a place to gather and connect since 1937. At Sheraton, associates create a sense of belonging in more than 400 communities around the world. We invite, we welcome, and we connect guests through engaging experiences and thoughtful service. If you’re a team player who is excited to deliver a meaningful guest experience, we encourage you to explore your next career opportunity with Sheraton. Join us on our mission to be ‘The World’s Gathering Place’. In joining Sheraton Hotels & Resorts, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

jobs.title: HRBP Sr. Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** As an **HRBP Associate**, you will be the key people partner for our Research & Development, Expansion, and Quality teams. You will collaborate with division heads to align people strategies with business priorities, drive talent and performance programs, and create an environment where #HangryMates can thrive. You’ll also play a pivotal role in performance management across all Hangry Support functions. **What You’ll Do** * Serve as HR Business Partner to key departments, ensuring people practices directly support business goals. * Act as the Performance Management coordinator across all Hangry Support functions—driving implementation, calibration, and follow-up on performance cycles. * Partner with division heads on workforce planning, team development, employee engagement, and cultural initiatives. * Provide data-driven insights and action plans for improving team health, performance, and retention. * Advise managers on employee relations, organizational design, and team effectiveness. * Ensure compliance with company policies and labor regulations, while promoting a culture of trust and transparency. * Contribute to key People projects and process improvements that elevate the employee experience. **Requirements** **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or related fields. * 3–5 years of experience as an HRBP, OD, or in HR project roles with exposure to multiple departments or functions. * Strong business acumen and ability to connect people strategies with organizational needs. * Demonstrated ability in stakeholder management, OD, and change enablement. * Experienced in performance management cycles, feedback culture, and employee development. * Comfortable using HRIS and data to generate insights and influence decisions. * Strong communicator with high emotional intelligence and situational awareness. * Project management skills and ability to drive initiatives across teams. * Familiarity with labor law compliance and HR policy frameworks. **About Hangry** Hangry is not just a place for great food, but also a place for HangryMates to build remarkable careers. Founded in 2019, we've grown from an unknown local player to a company that competes head-to-head with global brands. We are a place full of people that embrace fun, challenge, ambitious goals, and collaborative working environment. **OUR DNA** * **Growth Mindset:** At Hangry, we're driven by growth and challenge. We never think we are smart enough, we’re always learning and improving. Wherever you start from, you'll find abundant opportunities for development. Hangry is a safe place to learn; we foster an environment where we learn from each other, share knowledge and experiences to help everyone grow and succeed. * **Team Spirit:** We build, support, and help each other so that together we can achieve our goals. We create a place where everyone is valued and cared for. We work on highly ambitious, dynamic, and challenging projects in an environment that is positive and most importantly - fun! * **Supportive Leadership:** Our leaders at Hangry are expected to embody approachability, humility, and commitment to their employees' success. They are also expected to listen, serve, and provide helpful guidance and insights to the team. * **Best Ideas Win:** We listen to ideas from every team member regardless of their position and seniority. It's not about who speaks, it's about the quality of the content. We have enjoyed breakthrough ideas from people across different levels and we are committed to continuing that habit. * **Work Smarter & Faster:** At Hangry, we value our time, hence we prioritize working smarter and faster. We always try to find ways to refine workflows & processes so that our team can focus on tasks that truly matter. **WHAT WE OFFER** * **Flexibility:** We encourage work-life balance with our hybrid working arrangement. Other than the designated Work From Office days, HangryMates can work from anywhere. We also cap meeting hours to make sure everyone has the chance to take care of their various areas of life other than work. * **Competitive Compensation:** We conduct regular benchmarking to ensure that your skills, experience, and dedication are rewarded with compensation that is competitive in the market. * **Health Benefit Program:** Your well-being matters to us. We provide a comprehensive health benefit package, ensuring easy access to quality healthcare for you and your family (\*including your spouse and two children). * **Mental Health Support:** Your mental health is just as important as your physical health. We offer free counseling services from professional psychologists to provide the support you need. * **Generous Paid Leave:** We respect your personal time. Enjoy 15 days of paid leave per year to disconnect from work, recharge, and unwind; with an additional day granted on every work anniversary, up to a total of 20 leave days annually. Join us at Hangry, where each day offers the opportunity to learn and thrive in a dynamic and challenging environment. It's more than just a job; it's a journey toward self-growth, supported by a collaborative and nurturing culture dedicated to your development.

jobs.title: Recruitment Officer (Magang)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Recruitment Intern Kami sedang mencari individu yang proaktif, komunikatif, teliti, dan memiliki ketertarikan kuat untuk mengembangkan karier di bidang **Human Resources, khususnya Talent Acquisition dan Recruitment**, untuk bergabung bersama tim kami sebagai **Recruitment Intern**. Dalam posisi ini, Anda akan terlibat langsung dalam proses rekrutmen, mulai dari pencarian kandidat hingga pengaturan dan koordinasi jadwal interview. Anda juga berkesempatan untuk berkolaborasi dengan tim HR dalam mengidentifikasi, menarik, dan menjalin komunikasi dengan kandidat potensial. jobs.title: Intern, Supply Chain Quality
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Values & Innovation** ----------------------- At Under Armour, we are committed to empowering those who strive for more, and the company's values - Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes and Stand for Equality - serve as both a roadmap for our teams and the qualities expected of every teammate. Our Values define and unite us, the beliefs that are the red thread that connects everyone at Under Armour. Our values are rallying cries, reminding us why we're here, and fueling everything we do. Our pursuit of better begins with innovation and with our team's mission of being the best. With us, you get the freedom to go further - no matter your role. That means developing, delivering, and selling the state-of-the-art products and digital tools that make top performers even better. If you are a current Under Armour teammate, **Purpose of Role** ------------------- During this 6-month full-time internship, the Supply Chain Quality Intern will * Gain a solid understanding of the eight stages of production, including related procedures, processes, and inspection requirements, * Develop a thorough knowledge of UA quality standards for Apparel, Accessories, and Footwear, * Acquire the ability on inspection garment, accessories and footwear properly including inspection procedures and standard, * Understand and be able to apply UA requirements and procedures, with particular focus on the Vendor Guide, Production & Logistics Manual (PLM), and Quality Manual, * Learn to effectively use the Pivot88 inspection system for quality evaluation and reporting, * Understand and able to apply some PPIC job description, * Understand and participate in PTH audits and CFA in-line correlation audits, including their objectives and execution, * Develop the ability to train factory personnel on UA quality standards and procedures * Improve professional communication skills to communicate with factories clearly, effectively, and confidently. **Your Impact** --------------- **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES** **The intern will be responsible for arranging their own rental accommodation during assignments at designated factories.** **GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION (APPAREL, ACCESSORIES AND FOOTWEAR)** During the first 2 weeks to 1 month of practical training on field, the intern must be familiar with the job duties below. Together with Field QA: * monitoring sewing quality based on UA high-quality standard by conducting inline inspection and follow up improvement including providing report and corrective action presentation. Together with Field QA/ CFA: * Monitor folding way and packaging: procedures and standard conducting Pre-final and Final inspection using Pivot88 * Conduct PP Meeting with review product risk assessment * Conduct CFA Inline correlation audit After 1.5-2 months of practical training on field, the Intern must be familiar with: * Checking and monitoring fabric inspection; 4 points system, color continuous, shade-band, blanket, fabric weight, Spectro reading and fuse interlining (inspection, procedures & reporting) * Checking and monitoring trim and accessories; procedures, inspection and reporting * Checking and monitoring laboratory testing; testing process, standard and reporting. * Checking and monitoring Embellishment (HTL, Printing and Embroidery); inspection procedures and reporting * Checking and monitoring Spreading and cut panel: inspection procedures, process and standard **SPECIFIC JOB DESCRIPTIONS FOR FOOTWEAR** Continue after 3-4 months practical footwear on field Intern QA must be familiar with below job desc: * Check material incoming and make sure all material passed laboratory test result before use in production. * Make sure cutting process following best practice. * Check preparation and 2nd process PFC and best practice of upper include make sure test result * Check stitching process following PFC and best practice * Check bottom process rubber, injection phylon, CMP, EVA before send to stock fitting process6. Check stock fitting process * Check and monitor Assembly process * Check bonding process and laboratory test result * Evaluate every model and each hour shoes quality at finishing line * Check inspection following UA quality standards Ultimately, the intern is expected to provide PPT presentations for all above points and present them to related departments. **Additional Job Desc related to PPIC department** After 1-2 weeks of practical training related to PPIC, the intern is expected to assist in: * making Packing list, shipping status, * calculating fabric consumption, * inventory control of packaging material. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree from any major is welcome; Fresh graduate is also welcome * Fluent in English * Welcome students from any year of study **Relocation** -------------- * No relocation provided **Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity** --------------------------------------- At Under Armour, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, family or paternal status and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Under Armour seeks to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people representing a wide variety of backgrounds and perspectives. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact our Human Resources team via candidateaccommodations@underarmour.com. Requisition ID: 167932 Location: Central Jakarta, Jakarta, ID, 10310 Business Unit: Internships Region: APAC Employee Class: Part Time Employment Type: Hourly

jobs.title: People Culture & Engagement Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** **About The Role** **The People Culture & Engagement Analyst** plays an important role in fostering a positive workplace culture and enhancing employee engagement and experience. This role coordinates culture initiatives, engagement programs, and internal communications while gathering employee feedback to drive meaningful improvements. Working collaboratively across teams, this role promotes Honesty, Empathy, and Agility by encouraging transparent communication, creating inclusive employee experiences, and adapting engagement initiatives to evolving organizational needs. **What You'll Do (Responsibilities)** * Coordinate employee engagement programs, including recognition initiatives, company events, workshops, and team-building activities to strengthen employee connection and morale. * Execute culture and values-driven initiatives that promote inclusion, wellness, and a positive workplace environment. * Develop and manage internal communications, including announcements, newsletters, and engagement campaigns to keep employees informed and connected. * Support onboarding and cultural integration initiatives to help new hires understand the company's culture, values, and workplace practices. * Collect and analyze employee feedback, survey results, and engagement metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities. * Maintain engagement documentation and reports to monitor participation, evaluate program effectiveness, and support continuous improvement. **Requirements** **What Capabilities You'll Need (Requirements)** * Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Communications, Psychology, Marketing, or a related field. * 1–2 years of experience in Employee Engagement, People/HR, Internal Communications, Culture, or related roles. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in managing programs, activities, and communications. * Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create engaging internal content. * Basic analytical skills, with the ability to collect feedback, maintain records, and interpret engagement data. * Creative, empathetic, and collaborative, with a genuine interest in workplace culture and employee experience. * Adaptable and proactive in responding to changing organizational needs and supporting various initiatives. * Demonstrates **Honesty** through transparent communication, **Empathy** through understanding employee needs, and **Agility** through adaptability, creativity, and continuous improvement. **About PT Esensi Solusi Buana (ESB)** Established in 2018, **ESB** is Indonesia’s leading **restaurant technology company**, empowering the food and beverage industry with innovative, integrated, and easy-to-use digital solutions. Our comprehensive ecosystem enables businesses to seamlessly manage every aspect of their F&B operations—from front-of-house to back-of-house—so they can focus on what truly matters: **delivering great experiences and growing their business**. Whether you operate a **small food stall, a bustling café, a cloud kitchen, or a nationwide restaurant chain**, ESB provides a unified platform that simplifies operations, enhances efficiency, and drives performance. Today, ESB proudly partners with some of Indonesia’s most prominent and fast-growing brands, including **Starbucks, The People's Cafe, Bakerzin, Kimukatsu**, and countless **viral restaurants, cafés, and coffee shops** across the nation. At ESB, we live by our core values of **Honesty, Empathy, and Agility**—building technology with integrity, understanding our customers’ challenges, and adapting swiftly to an ever-changing industry landscape. Join a **growing, fast-paced, and dynamic technology company** that’s shaping the future of Indonesia’s F&B industry. It’s time to **grow, learn, and make an impact with us.** **#GrowingWithESB**

jobs.title: Asst. Human Resources Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** **Responsibilities:** * Support in overseeing all HR functions including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, training and compliances. * Assist in developing and executing talent strategies, including performance management, succession planning, training, and career development programs. * Assist in developing and executing employee engagement initiatives and to support on managing programs to achieve an optimal employee satisfaction. * Assist in controlling payroll processing, ensuring alignment with Indonesian legal requirements and industry standards. * Assist in HR data analysis and reporting to provide insights for strategic decision-making * Responsible for the recruitment process, onboarding, orientation program. * Responsible for industrial relations and disciplinary processes, from warnings to termination. * Supporting in conducting salary research or benchmarking to maintain competitive and fair compensation structures. * Collaborate on HR-related projects and assignments related to Health & Safety and to support business objectives. **Requirements** **Requirements and background:** * Male/Female * Bachelor’s Degree in any field * Minimum 5 years of experience in HR Operations supervisory level including Recruitment, Payroll & HRIS * Fluent in English (required) * Strong organizational and administrative skills * Ability to maintain confidentiality * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills * Proficiency in HR software and databases * Knowledge of employment laws and regulations. Knowledge in rewards strategy is a plus * Problem-solving and conflict resolution skills * Proactive, self-motivated, and dynamic mindset with a results-oriented approach **About John Hardy** Artisan Handcrafted Since 1975 Drawing inspiration from Bali’s elemental beauty, we are guided by our heritage of artistry and reverence for nature in everything we do. We Are Artisans Our fine jewelry is an ongoing collaboration amongst our artisan collective. The soul and hand of the maker are expressed in every piece. We Are Community For us, creation is a collective process fueled by community. That’s why we’re dedicated to ours, which includes over 700 multi-generational artisans in Bali and 400 in Thailand – all masters in the arts of chain weaving, carving, casting, and metalsmithing. With over 1,000 employees worldwide, we also have offices in Bali, Hong Kong and headquarter in New York City. We Are Sustainable As a certified member of the Responsible Jewellery Council, we are committed to ethical practices across our supply chain. We use only reclaimed metals and ethically sourced gemstones as well as Kimberly Process-compliant diamonds.

jobs.title: HR COORDINATOR
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Hotel Tugu Bali is hiring for HR Coordinator!** Qualifications * Bachelor's degree (S1) in Human Resource Management, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field. * Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably within the hospitality industry. * Strong knowledge of Indonesian labor laws and HR practices, including employment contracts (PKWT/PKWTT), BPJS Kesehatan, and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. * Experienced in recruitment and selection, employee onboarding and offboarding, employee administration, and HR documentation. * Familiar with HR administration, employee relations, attendance monitoring, and personnel records management. * Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. * Strong attention to detail, proactive, responsible, and able to work independently. * Good problem-solving skills and ability to handle multiple HR tasks efficiently. * Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. * Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and good command of English. * Willing to work in a dynamic hospitality environment. Key Responsibilities * Manage daily HR operations and employee administration. * Handle recruitment and selection processes for various hotel departments. * Prepare and manage employment contracts, employee files, and HR documentation. * Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable labor regulations. * Manage BPJS administration and employee data updates. * Coordinate onboarding, offboarding, and employee engagement activities. * Support training and development activities in coordination with department heads. * Maintain accurate employee records and prepare HR reports. * Provide HR support and guidance to employees and department heads. Job Type: Full-time Work Location: In person

jobs.title: HR Recruitment Officer (Internship)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Deskripsi Pekerjaan * Membantu seluruh tahapan proses rekrutmen, mulai dari pencarian kandidat (*sourcing*), seleksi CV (*screening*), hingga tindak lanjut kandidat (*follow-up*). * Mencari kandidat potensial melalui berbagai platform lowongan kerja, LinkedIn, media sosial, dan kanal rekrutmen lainnya. * Melakukan seleksi CV berdasarkan kualifikasi dan kebutuhan posisi yang sedang dibuka. * Menghubungi kandidat potensial serta melakukan komunikasi awal terkait posisi yang tersedia. * Mengatur jadwal wawancara dan berkoordinasi dengan kandidat maupun tim internal. * Melakukan tindak lanjut kepada kandidat terkait jadwal wawancara, kelengkapan dokumen, dan perkembangan proses seleksi. * Mengelola dan memperbarui database kandidat, status rekrutmen, serta recruitment tracker secara berkala. * Membantu menyiapkan dokumen, materi, dan kebutuhan administrasi yang berkaitan dengan proses rekrutmen. * Berkoordinasi dengan tim internal untuk memastikan proses rekrutmen berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif. * Membantu kegiatan administrasi serta operasional HR lainnya sesuai kebutuhan. Kualifikasi * **Wajib berdomisili di Jakarta.** * **Wajib berstatus sebagai mahasiswa aktif minimal semester 5 atau lulusan S1 maksimal tahun 2026.** * Terbuka untuk mahasiswa dan lulusan dari semua jurusan. * Tidak memerlukan pengalaman kerja sebelumnya (terbuka untuk pemula). * Memiliki ketertarikan pada bidang **Human Resources, Recruitment, dan Talent Acquisition**. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan interpersonal yang baik, baik secara lisan maupun tulisan. * Percaya diri dalam berkomunikasi dan melakukan tindak lanjut kepada kandidat. * Teliti, terorganisir, proaktif, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu mengatur waktu dengan baik. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. * Memiliki kemampuan mengoperasikan Microsoft Office atau Google Workspace menjadi nilai tambah. * Bersedia mengikuti seluruh tahapan rekrutmen dan wawancara secara **langsung (onsite)**. Wawancara online tidak tersedia. * Memiliki komitmen untuk mengikuti program magang sesuai periode yang telah ditentukan. Application Question(s): * Berapa usia Anda saat ini? * Dimana domisili Anda saat ini? * Jika masih mahasiswa, saat ini Anda berada di semester berapa? * Jika sudah lulus, kapan Anda menyelesaikan pendidikan S1? Jurusan dan universitas Anda? * Apakah Anda berdomisili di Jakarta? Posisi ini hanya terbuka untuk kandidat yang berdomisili di Jakarta. * Apakah Anda memiliki pengalaman kerja sebelumnya? * Apakah Anda bersedia menjalani program ini sebagai unpaid internship? * Kapan Anda dapat mulai mengikuti internship dan apakah Anda memiliki komitmen waktu yang cukup untuk menjalani program ini? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: IT Recruiter
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** * Managing the end-to-end recruitment process from Sourcing, Screening, Interviewing, User Interview Scheduling, Background Checking, and Offering Process. * Sourcing and hunting talents using Job portal, LinkedIn and other channels. * Build trust and good relationships with talents that will benefit both parties in the long run. * Coordinate with Sales & Account Manager Team and HR to ensure the recruitment process goes smoothly. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field. * Proven experience as a Technical Recruiter with 1+ year of experience in the field * Having experience working in IT Consulting or Headhunting industry. * Hands-on experience with various selection processes (Sourcing, Screening, Interviewing, User Interview Scheduling, Background Checking, and Offering Process). * Good communication in English. * Good interpersonal skills. * Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. * Willing to work in South Jakarta * Willing to learn new things and passionate with recruitment Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kuningan Timur 12950
